direct.short: Архетип Двойка Жезлов: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description: A situation when it is impossible to act in the old way. One needs new skills they don't have now. It can irritate and anger or make you blame others for your failure. The card rarely comes out of the blue. Usually, there are some signs that it is time to learn new things but a person holds on to the past and ignores them. One can see the card as a negative one but it has a positive meaning in a broad sense because, with the help of such situations, destiny forces the person to develop for their own good. It might concern professional skills, new knowledge, different behavior, new character traits.
direct.advice: Learn new things, acquire new skills.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Двойка Жезлов: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: New opportunities for further development. In this situation, destiny does not make a person learn, but it encourages them to acquire skills they will need in the future. It can come to you in the form of new information or a proposal that caught your eye. It may not be obvious at first what kind of results the undertaking will bring. However, if you follow your gut feeling and seize the opportunities, you will enjoy great benefits in the time to come. If you ignore the chance, you can find yourself in such a situation in the future when these skills won't be enough.
reversed.advice: Focus on all the offers you receive. Take the opportunity to learn something new, acquire new skills.

direct.short: Архетип Луна: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
First meaning
Fears. Most often these are deep subconscious programs. They can stem from personal experience or family programs, even past lives. They are irrational and beyond our control. The card means that the process is blocked by internal fears you may not even be aware of.

Second meaning
Illusions, false perception of reality. A person misunderstands the situation and starts reading too much into it. They get all worked up and come up with explanations. Most people do that sometimes. The card may also point out the beginning of mental health problems.
direct.advice:
First meaning
Don't rely on the Moon in this matter. Your fear controls you. Focus your energy on finding and fighting your fear.

Second meaning
Do not read too much into it. It is better to ask again, clarify, double-check the information. It's highly likely that you are just overthinking too much.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Луна: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:
First meaning
Fears that do not truly belong to us. They can be born from two sources: from the outside or from the inside. External fears arise from other people who trigger them, making them more intense. One constantly deals with negative information, and it stays in their subconsciousness in the form of fear. It can also be a feeding frenzy in the society, mass hysteria, which only intensifies fears. An internal source is when one hears a voice of their family member or relatives inside. The fear belonged to them, but the person communicated with them so often that in the end this fear became their own. To understand the source of your fear, you need to ask the cards clarifying questions.

Second meaning
Wrong ideas that came from the outside. Someone made a person believe in this illusion. They trusted their words and got sidetracked.
reversed.advice:
First meaning
Don't act out of fear. Find its source. If it's someone outside, then distance yourself, break off this contact, set boundaries. Or deal with inner fears that don't belong to you.

Second meaning
Stop, don't get so worked up. What you have heard is not true. Double-check this information.

direct.short: Архетип Шестерка Кубков: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
Nostalgia, memories. They are usually accompanied by a surge of emotions and a slight sadness about the past. The card can take on a negative meaning if a person gets stuck in this state for a long time. They cling to memories and stop moving forward.
The specific meaning in esoteric spreads: past lives.
direct.advice: Don't live in the past, don't look back so often. In case memories can become a resource and give you strength to improve the situation, the card advises you to recall how things were before.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Шестерка Кубков: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: A valuable skill or experience from the past that can be adapted to a current situation and implemented in new conditions. It can concern the format of work, ideas, behavior, special skills. In the past, a person had already mastered the knowledge and skills that can help them now.
reversed.advice: You have valuable baggage from the past. Think about these skills, transform them and create something new to achieve your current goals.

direct.short: Архетип Колесница: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
The card has 2 meanings. You can identify which one applies by the nature of your question, or use a clarifying spread.

First meaning
Some time ago, you faced a serious choice and made the right decision — you followed your heart. Now your life is speeding up. All the undertakings that take place during this period are the most favorable and necessary for your development. A quick pace can be challenging and exhausting but it isn't time to rest — you need to accept events and make the best out of everything that comes to your life. The Chariot implies that events follow each other and bring the best result. Slowing down the pace and events can lead to negative karma.

Second meaning
The specific meaning in questions concerning the success of a one-time event in the future: a one-time victory. In this case, everything will turn out in the best possible way, luck is on your side.
direct.advice:
First meaning
Make the most of your Chariot of life. Throw yourself into new beginnings and current processes as hard as you can. The more you do now, the more it will benefit you. If your question is about the future, wait for the Chariot to put your plans into action.

Second meaning
A one-time victory is ahead.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Колесница: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: A person can't keep up with the pace of the Chariot and tries to slow things down. The speed is too fast, so they get out of processes trying to avoid the hustle and bustle. In a relationship, this can mean that things are moving too quickly and one of the partners deliberately keeps distance in order to slow them down. Work-wise, this might be an attempt to give up something in order to ease the workload. However, now is the best time to take advantage of your opportunities. You will have to get involved in these processes anyway sooner or later but under less favorable circumstances.
reversed.advice: Do not try to slow things down. They will reach you anyway but in a less favorable situation. Take action now.

direct.short: Архетип Шут: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
Courage and audacity. The Fool's energy draws on the divine right of free will — the right to create your own reality rather than follow a predetermined fate. In its purest form, this impulse is always constructive and positive. When a person catches and holds it, they can achieve absolutely anything, defying all logic. They do truly brave things and reach even impossible goals no matter what stands in their way. The Fool fills a person with confidence, persuading them that everything will work out, and gives them a bright, healthy drive to act.
Others may doubt, disapprove, or try to discourage. The most important thing is not to listen to them — don't be afraid, and keep that energy alive within you. With it, you can radically change your destiny and step into an entirely different reality. Through bold action and inner faith, life changes. Events of a different level and quality begin to unfold. The Fool holds the highest potential for transformation of any card, because it obeys no laws — not even destiny.
direct.advice: Go for it. Act boldly, think outside the box, and take risks. If you have the courage to go all the way without looking back at other people, doubts, or setbacks, you can change your reality. But if you're not ready to take risks and keep going in spite of everything, don't start at all — there may be many challenges ahead, and holding the Fool's impulse is no easy thing.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Шут: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: These are unfavorable circumstances that must be overcome in order to reach the Fool. They represent difficulties that have already stopped this person before — they got scared and didn't take the risk. Now that they've chosen to try again, everything they once feared is coming to pass. This is a test: does the person have enough determination this time, or will they give up again? If they can push through all the obstacles, success awaits them — the Fool's creative impulse is there at the end of the road. But the chance of reaching it is slim, because the path is a very hard one.
reversed.advice: Make up your mind: are you truly ready to overcome every obstacle and change your life? If you are, then face every difficulty without looking back and see it through to the end.

direct.short: Архетип The Blank Сard: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
First meaning
Divine energy. The Higher Powers give a person a very powerful flow of pure strength as a reward for following the path of destiny. This is a target energy — it is given to solve a specific task that a person chose themselves. Nevertheless, if they spend it on something else, there will be no negative consequences. Usually it appears in the form of an excellent, interesting opportunity, new information. The scale of the card depends on the question: in terms of everyday matters, the card means a good chance to deal with this situation. If the question concerns significant moments in life, then the card promises a huge amount of concentrated energy that can help a person to change their destiny. By directing this enormous strength into work, they can create a new reality for themselves.

Second meaning
The specific aspect in the spreads about subjective reality (thoughts, feelings, emotions, people's plans): self-deception. Other cards in the spread will tell you more details.
direct.advice: Seize a new opportunity. If you try and realize its full potential, you can radically change your life.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект The Blank Сard: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: The Blank card always has only one (upright) meaning.
reversed.advice: Обратите внимание на скрытые сомнения и не форсируйте результат.

direct.short: Архетип Десятка Кубков: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description: An abrupt change in attitude. A person found out something — heard or saw, and their attitude changed. The card only indicates the fact of the change, but to understand if it is for the better or worse, one should take into account either the circumstances of the question, or other cards. It is impossible to treat another person or see a situation as before. Also, the card can mean a new level of feeling — the appearance of a feeling that one has never had before. Often it arises from important events such as finding love, the birth of children, the loss of a loved one.
direct.advice: Accept the change in your attitude. Allow yourself to feel different, be in sync with this experience, live through it.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Десятка Кубков: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: A slow change in attitude. A person observes, learns more information, and their attitude is slowly changing for the better, worse or getting neutral. This card is not about major changes.
reversed.advice: Let your attitude change as the situation unfolds.

direct.short: Архетип Туз Жезлов: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
The beginning of a new process that can improve life in terms of its social part. It concerns the conditions of the processes, their comfort, and the external communication of people. The main condition here is the desire of a person to develop. In order for the card to fulfill its positive potential, it is necessary to invest energy, put in a lot of effort and change the visible side of life for the better. The arrival of the Ace of Wands may not be obvious and imperceptible: a person doesn't know yet if their undertaking will bring results.
The scale of the event depends on the choice: small things that will add convenience and comfort or global life issues. This is not a fateful card — there is no need to implement every Ace of Wands, as they appear quite regularly. In questions about work, the card shows that there are opportunities for growth and establishing your authority, if you try and do your best.
direct.advice: Use this opportunity to change your life for the better. Your efforts will bring positive results.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Туз Жезлов: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: Wrong actions that got in the way of the natural positive course of events. Perhaps, a person rushed things or broke written or unwritten rules. These can be late arrivals, mistakes, inappropriate communication style, breaking promises, or other negative things in terms of social interactions. The card says you can try to fix the situation but a positive outcome can't be guaranteed.
reversed.advice: Stop breaking rules and take your time. Destiny wants you to correct your actions, then things can still get better.

direct.short: Архетип Четверка Мечей: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description: The calm time according to destiny. The moment has come when you need to stop and wait. It's not the time for actions, they will not bring the desired results. The card is perceived negatively, as a person puts in a lot of effort but it doesn't pay off. Everything in life stops, no important events happen. During such periods the head is empty. There is no plan, so any actions are chaotic and useless. The second meaning is an obstacle. It seems that something is standing in the way and one has to take action to overcome it. However, actions do not bring any results. The arrival of the Four of Swords in the spread means that these obstacles are designed to stop a person. They will only waste their energy on something that will not work anyway.
direct.advice: It's not the right time for your question. Now you need to make a pause. Do not take active actions, do not try to overcome any obstacles. Switch your attention to another area.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Четверка Мечей: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: A person tries to resist destiny and take action when it is necessary not to do anything. They are trying to overcome obstacles, but do not achieve any results.
reversed.advice: Stop and calm down. Your attempts won't be successful, you will only lose your energy. Accept this calm period in life sent by destiny and it will do you good.

direct.short: Архетип Шестерка Пентаклей: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
First meaning
A gift from destiny. There is a chance to prove yourself at a new level and take hold of it. It does not come by pure chance — a person invested their strength and resources, worked, developed, walked towards this goal. As a gift for their efforts, destiny gives them an excellent opportunity to thrive. However, you can't relax in this situation: if you do not take advantage of the chance and put yourself into it, it will disappear.

Second meaning
In some specific questions, the card can symbolize a gift.
direct.advice: This is a gift opportunity from destiny, seize it. How things will develop further depends only on how you take up this opportunity. If there isn't such an opportunity in your life now, and your question is really difficult, then the card advises you to keep going and wait for a gift situation.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Шестерка Пентаклей: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: Obsession with one option. A person has a clear vision of how it should be and blindly insists that it's the only right choice. They see the other options but do not want to even consider them since they seem unacceptable. In the moment of obsession, they do not realize they're being narrow-minded and too persistent. It can be an obsession with a job, a person, a specific task, intention, or idea. The scale depends on the question: everyday matters or serious life patterns.
reversed.advice: Don't limit yourself and rely only on one option. Consider other possibilities. If the question is about the future, the card warns that you can cling to one option, and advises you not to let this happen.

direct.short: Архетип Двойка Мечей: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description: A tandem of two people who understand each other well on a particular issue. This is a positive card for business matters and work. However, in questions about relationships, it means that partners see each other as companions, close people, but not as lovers. There is neither passion nor emotions between them. Also, the card can reflect a person's inner process. They were torn between two opposite points of view and could not decide which one was correct, finally, they managed to find a solution that settled the internal conflict.
direct.advice: Find the right partner, do business together.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Двойка Мечей: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: A conflict between two people. In another situation, they could create a tandem and successfully complement each other, but now there is a confrontation between them because each is trying to enter the territory of the other and impose their opinion. It can also mean an inner conflict when a person is on the fence about something. That's why their actions are inconsistent and often contradictory.
reversed.advice: In case of a conflict with another person, split areas of responsibility and agree not to criticize each other's actions. In case of an inner conflict — take a look at the situation from another angle and come to a final decision.

direct.short: Архетип Восьмерка Жезлов: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
A situation when you need to make a quick choice. It can radically change the course of your life. The card appears when a person wants to get to the next higher level because the current one does not satisfy them any longer. It is a test of destiny — is a person really ready for radical changes? There comes a new opportunity, offer, and information. However, there is only a day to make a decision. If a person chooses new opportunities, then they pass the test and show that they are ready to move forward. It is not guaranteed that everything will turn out favorably in terms of the question they asked — this offer may not live up to their expectations. Nevertheless, the main thing is that they reached a new level and started making positive changes in their life. After this, everything will work out in their favor.
If the person hesitates and eventually gives up the opportunity, it won't have any negative consequences. Destiny understands they are not ready yet, so it has to wait. However, if you refuse offers several times in a row, that will bring negative karma — fear hinders your development.
The third option: if the person waited for too long to make a choice and agreed only a day later. Anyway, fate starts moving towards positive changes but in unfavorable conditions. There are some difficulties that cropped up and could have been avoided if the decision had been made quickly. It takes more effort.
Also, there might be not an external, but an internal choice — how the person will react to a certain situation. Can they take a fresh look at the world or are they going to act as they are used to? Destiny is testing if the person is ready for the next level.
direct.advice: Make your choice quickly, without hesitation. Choose a new path, new opportunities — they will bring you some great life improvements.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Восьмерка Жезлов: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:
A process that must be left behind but a person has delayed making a choice and now they are stuck in it. They did not make a decision when it was necessary, so now things are only getting worse. One might get fired, have a break-up, quit a project or end communication with someone. Things escalate quickly and seem to push the person out of the process. When they finally leave, there follows a period of emptiness and lack of options. They missed an opportunity and have to wait for the next one. The card can mean either a period of aggravation of the situation, or a period of calm.
The reversed Eight of Wands can be favorable when the person needs this period of silence in order to be alone, to reevaluate things and realize something. Then there will be positive cards near the Eight of Wands in the spread that are saying that it is the right thing to do now.
reversed.advice: Do not delay processes that are long overdue. Get out of them before the situation starts to get worse. If you experience a period of calm, then wait for the next opportunity.

direct.short: Архетип Дьявол (Искушение): внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
First meaning
Addictions. Everything that deprives a person of their free will, conscious choice. They rely not on their true desires, deepest needs, feelings, but on addictions. The person subconsciously adjusts their decisions to them. Everyone has their own addictions: people, work, money, behavior, public opinion, children, food, alcohol, smoking, and so on. Even addiction to something positive (healthy lifestyle, sports) is harmful in a global sense. All of them take away one's right to free will given from above and one is punished by fate for them. The person has to face tough circumstances, problems, and negative situations to overcome their addiction. It puts them in a difficult position, brings discomfort and anguish.

Second meaning
The specific aspect in questions concerning work, finance: money in a negative context. This can be a loss or lack of money, difficulties in relationships because of it, low income, expenses.

Third meaning
The specific aspect in certain questions: sex as a purely physiological process that does not necessarily imply feelings. The card either points out that the topic is important for a person or shows sex peculiarities — problematic, crazy, adrenergic.
direct.advice:
First meaning
Become aware of your addictions and, if possible, get rid of them. They don't have to rule your life.

Second meaning
Sort out your financial problems.

Third meaning
Direct your attention to the sexual side.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Дьявол (Искушение): время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:
First meaning
A person is on the verge of getting addicted but has not crossed the line yet. The Devil already sees but can't control them. The situation is getting worse.

Second meaning
The specific aspect in particular questions coincides with the specific aspect of the upright card.
reversed.advice: Stop now, you can still avoid addiction. Focus on it and take action so as not to face the Devil.

direct.short: Архетип Возрождение (Суд): внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description: A significant upgrade, a leap to a new level in the area the question was about. This is a beautiful, powerful period in life when a person is improving their quality of life. There are important positive changes happening. One has a lot of energy they manage to realize. The transition to Judgement is going on comfortably and under favorable circumstances. It has tremendous potential, however people rarely realize it to the fullest because of their fears or excessive caution.
direct.advice: Use Judgement. Do not be afraid, open up to and trust it. Go bravely into this process relying on the support of fate. If the question is about the future, wait for Judgement, you will need the most favorable circumstances and the help of the higher powers.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Возрождение (Суд): время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: Here comes the period of Judgement but a person resists it and tries to take something old into a new life. They feel that it is time to let it go, but their old habits and fear play their part and slow down the person. These can be people, circumstances, old conditions and programs, manners and habits, and attitude towards the issue. They are no longer relevant and therefore do not let the person enter the new reality. Destiny will force them to give up the old and get Judgement into its upright position.
reversed.advice: Give up something old that interferes with your new life and hinders your development.

direct.short: Архетип Пятерка Пентаклей: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
First meaning
Taking risks at the wrong time. A person overestimated themselves and did something beyond their capabilities. Now they are faced with obstacles and challenges that are very difficult to overcome. If you put together all your resources and go through a number of difficulties, then your success is a sure thing. However, the path will be so difficult that it is highly unlikely that you will get to the end.

Second meaning
Stupidity, whim. One realizes that their efforts were not worth it. A person overdid themselves and lost time and energy as a result.
direct.advice: Your question requires a lot of effort and makes you step on a path full of obstacles. Either don't go there, or be ready not to stop and go to the end, no matter what happens. This is the only way to achieve what you want. Think carefully if it's worth it.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Пятерка Пентаклей: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: Deficit thinking. A person sees only bad things, focuses only on what they did not get, what they were not given. They evaluate everything through comparison to others and do not notice the good. Focusing on the negative can become a personality trait that is difficult to get rid of.
reversed.advice: Change the way you think. Deliberately focus on the positive. Over time, it will get easier to do this.

direct.short: Архетип Пятерка Жезлов: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description: New actions in the direction of changes that a person has recently made or is making right now. Before that, there was a calm period of routine and stability, and now with these actions, they turn their life around and move to a new level. A lot of things are changing, so the card might cause fear, a sense of risk, anticipation. It can also mean a conversation, after which nothing will be the same. The card does not promise that you will be able to complete what you started. It depends on your courage and the decision to go all the way to change your life for the better. The only situation when the card can be negative is if a person is fed up with their routine, and is trying to break out of it too early, doing the wrong things. For example, they leave their family, drop out of school, although now is not the best moment to do it, they need to wait. To clarify the meaning, it is better to do additional spreads.
direct.advice: You are in a transitional moment when the usual way of life is not possible anymore. Take brave actions to break free from boredom and routine. You are ready to change your life.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Пятерка Жезлов: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: A person took a step towards changes, but reconsidered and turned back. They stopped an important action without completing it, or even pretending they didn't do anything at all. Perhaps, the person was controlled by fear and didn't want to take risks. The emotional color of the card is inner dissatisfaction with yourself that triggers either self-pity (an attempt to blame others for your troubles), or self-flagellation (persuading yourself of your own inferiority and inability to do something). One possible reaction is an attempt to convince yourself that these actions are not needed, everything is fine as it is. At this stage, there is still an opportunity to complete the process and reach a new level but each next attempt will make it more difficult.
reversed.advice: You are trying to run away and back down. Don't do that. Complete the actions that are necessary for changing your life for the better.

direct.short: Архетип Паж Мечей: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description: There are some changes concerning the idea and assessment of the situation, beliefs, plans. The degree depends on the question — it can be your worldview in a broad sense, a view of the world and your place in it, or an answer to a specific question about a particular situation, process, project. The card indicates planting a seed of change — an idea has already turned up in the mental field of a person, but it is not clear if they will welcome it or get back to their previous patterns. How the person will handle new information, behave, and use the opportunities depends only on them. Also, the card can speak about the emergence of a general idea, intentions in their infancy, when it is not clear yet whether they will develop and grow into a plan of action.
direct.advice: Direct your attention to a new idea. Think it over, make a clear plan. The outcome will depend only on how thoroughly you analyze everything and how you use new opportunities.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Паж Мечей: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: The meaning coincides with the Page of Swords in the upright position.
reversed.advice: Обратите внимание на скрытые сомнения и не форсируйте результат.

direct.short: Архетип Семерка Кубков: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
First meaning
The feeling of love. Each person needs love and creates a subconscious image of their ideal partner. When they meet somebody who fits this image, their astral body starts releasing love energy — they fall in love. This is a strong and beautiful feeling, but it is not given from above — a person creates it themselves, that's why they have a lot of illusions. They expect their partner to be exactly the way they want to see them. As a result, after some time, when the partner starts showing their true self and doesn't live up to an ideal image, it is getting more and more difficult to love them. There comes a feeling everything was different before, although only the inner perception has changed. This is how falling in love ends. It may be followed either by a break-up or the emergence of a deeper feeling of love without any illusions. However, the love of the Seven of Cups is also beautiful — it brings out the best in a person, changes them for the better. Its nature is typical of humans.

Second meaning
Illusions. A person prefers to see what they want, and it hides the reality from them. Perhaps, they are not aware of all the details, don't look into the situation, or just refuse to think straight.
direct.advice:
First meaning
Let yourself love, learn its lessons. This feeling has a lot of potential.

Second meaning
Get rid of illusions. Rely only on real facts and draw conclusions from the current state of affairs.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Семерка Кубков: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: Lack of love. A person is suffering from a lack of emotions and no proof of love from their partner. Work-wise, there might be a feeling that one is not appreciated and their work doesn't pay off. This lack of feelings forces them to take proactive steps to get love and a sense of importance. It often happens through pain and tears, one can even provoke quarrels and scandals in order to get at least some emotions, even negative ones.
reversed.advice: Take action to feel loved and significant. Take the initiative to improve the situation and get satisfied.

direct.short: Архетип Король Мечей: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
First meaning
The King of Swords of the man that the question is about. In this meaning it is connected with the zodiac sign according to the Western horoscope. Swords are a suit of people born under the Earth signs — Virgo, Capricorn, Taurus. Thus, if the man belongs to one of these three signs and you know about it, then the card can have this meaning. If he belongs to another sign, or you do not know his sign of the zodiac, then it's not the case — look for the answer in the second or third meaning.
The King of Swords represents a man as he is, with his own strengths and weaknesses, peculiarities, individual qualities. This is a "home" card, as if you are at home. It allows you to be your true self, and in this situation it is favorable. In this job, in this relationship, in this place, he is needed just the way he is. But one has to understand that both positive and negative traits come to the surface. The card does not judge: depending on the context of your question, merits or demerits will play a bigger role. If there is a choice between two options in the spread, and there appears the King of Swords, the cards say: no matter what advice we give, you will still do it your way.

Second meaning
Describes the character of a man. It has no connection with the zodiac sign. The King of Swords means willpower, determination, backbone. Such men know what they want and what needs to be done. They are persistent and goal-oriented, and have good organizational skills. They often have an analytical mind, an ability to see the full picture and draw conclusions. Such men might be prone to cruelty, rudeness, obstinacy, and can't admit their mistakes.
The card describes general traits of character but each person is individual and shows themselves in their own way.
Also, the card can refer to a man who does not fit this description but behaved like the King of Swords in a particular situation.

Third meaning
A dark magician. A person who intentionally or unconsciously sends negative energy. They have either the necessary knowledge and skills for this, or such a strong intention that manifests itself in reality. This is an extremely rare meaning that concerns only the spreads about magic.
direct.advice:
First meaning
Be yourself. This is exactly what you need to do in this situation.

Second meaning
Be the King of Swords. Show your will and determination, achieve your goals.

Third meaning
Protect yourself from the influence of the dark magician.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Король Мечей: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:
First meaning
Showing your worst personality traits. In this situation, a man revealed some of his major flaws, and that had a negative effect on his life.

Second meaning
The King of Swords is offended. The reaction to the offense depends on the personality traits. He may not get involved in a quarrel and just keep silent, however he harbors anger in his soul and can take revenge later. Most often the card speaks of cruelty and aggression. It comes out in situations when a man got into a fight, raised his hand against a woman.
Also, the card can refer to a man who does not fit this description but behaved like the King of Swords in a particular situation.

Third meaning
Aggression of a dark magician. Their evil will is directed against a specific person.
reversed.advice:
First meaning
Try not to do this. Work on yourself so that you can control yourself. If the question is about the future, then some situation will trigger your worst qualities, so try to escape it if possible.

Second meaning
Don't show your aggression and cruelty, learn to react more calmly.

Third meaning
Protect yourself from the influence of the dark magician.

direct.short: Архетип Тройка Кубков: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description: A one-time victory, one-time success. A person got lucky because everything worked out for them. They won though they could easily lose, and that kept them out of trouble. If a question concerns a one-time event, the card predicts success. The difficulties to be faced won't have negative consequences and won't affect significant aspects of life.
direct.advice: Be grateful for what happened. However, you need to understand that this won't always be the case — the card means a one-time success.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Тройка Кубков: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: Anxiety, sadness. A certain life period is coming to an end. It won't be the same anymore, and that can cause melancholy. Also, the card means that all the difficulties, actions, and mistakes will have consequences. This time, you won't get lucky, so any argument won't go unnoticed. If you managed to get away with revealing your true character earlier, now you can get yourself into trouble.
reversed.advice: If you don't want something to end, there is still an opportunity to fix everything and save the situation. Don't rely on pure luck, in this situation it will not come to your rescue.

direct.short: Архетип Король Жезлов: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
First meaning
The King of Wands of the man that the question is about. In this meaning it is connected with the zodiac sign according to the Western horoscope. Wands are a suit of people born under the fire signs — Sagittarius, Leo and Aries. Thus, if the man belongs to one of these three signs and you know about it, then the card can have this meaning. If he belongs to another sign, or you do not know his sign of the zodiac, then it's not the case — look for the answer in the second or third meaning.
The King of Wands represents a man as he is, with his own strengths and weaknesses, peculiarities, individual qualities. This is a "home" card, as if you are at home. It allows you to be your true self, and in this situation it is favorable. In this job, in this relationship, in this place, he is needed just the way he is. But one has to understand that both positive and negative traits come to the surface. The card does not judge: depending on the context of your question, merits or demerits will play a bigger role. If there is a choice between two options in the spread, and there appears the King of Wands, the cards say: no matter what advice we give, you will still do it your way.

Second meaning
Describes the character of the man. It has no connection with the zodiac sign. The King of Wands means socially approved behavior. A man's inner guidelines, his idea of "what is right" and "how it should be" coincide with the accepted norms. He is straightforward, punctual, polite, and always keeps his word. He has a strong sense of duty. This is a good, faithful man who has his own opinion of how things should be, and sticks to it. In a relationship, the King of Wands is a perfect husband and father. He might be prone to be too predictable, boring, inflexible, or to follow the rules without thinking. Also, the cards can consider the King of Wands as henpecked.
The card describes general traits of character but each person is individual and shows themselves in their own way.
Also, the card can refer to a man who does not fit this description but behaved like the King of Wands in a particular situation.

Third meaning
Social role. The card either speaks of a person in power (quite often these are civil servants), or simply indicates status. In each situation, a person has a certain status: a parent, spouse, leader, colleague, friend. Social status implies definite behavior. The card points out the status of the person in this situation, the rest of the cards in the spread will provide you with more answers.
direct.advice:
First meaning
Be yourself. This is exactly what you need to do in this situation.

Second meaning
Be the King of Wands. Behave properly, the way you are supposed to.

Third meaning
Act according to your social role. Show yourself in the way that fits your status.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Король Жезлов: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:
First meaning
Showing your worst personality traits. In this situation, a man revealed some of his major flaws, and that had a negative effect on his life.

Second meaning
The King of Wands is offended. The reaction to the offense depends on the personality traits. If the behavior of the other person is not consistent with the principles of the King of Wands, he is not able to accept it. It is very difficult to explain someone else's position to him.
Also, the card can refer to a man who does not fit this description but behaved like the King of Wands in a particular situation.

Third meaning
A person who breaks the rules within their social role. Their behavior doesn't fit their current status. For example, they act inappropriately as a boss, or as a parent. If the question is about the future, then in this situation one will have to break the rules.
reversed.advice:
First meaning
Try not to do this. Work on your temper, learn to control yourself. If the question is about the future, then some situation will trigger your worst qualities, so try to escape it if possible.

Second meaning
Be more flexible in your judgments.

Third meaning
Don't do this. Act according to your social role.

direct.short: Архетип Восьмерка Мечей: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description: The situation doesn't develop according to plan. A person acts as they are used to but this time it does not lead to the expected result. For example, they talk with their partner in the same manner but end up falling out. Or they use proven methods at work but face difficulties. It causes anger, irritation, and despair. The card seems heavy and negative, but it teaches an important lesson. It points out the illusion that everything depends on a person. However, in this situation no matter how carefully they calculate their moves or consider all possible options, things will not go the way they want. In fact, everything happens in a new way but not necessarily a bad one. From destiny's point of view, things go the way they should.
direct.advice: Relax and accept the situation as it is. Don't try to fight destiny. Consider the circumstances. If the question is about the future, be ready for the fact that everything might not go according to your plan and bring different results.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Восьмерка Мечей: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: A person resists destiny and tries to do everything in their own way. They keep acting the old way, but it does not work anymore, so they put too much effort and go too far, thereby harming themselves.
reversed.advice: Accept your destiny and do not resist, it will not bring results.

direct.short: Архетип Мир: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
A state of inner harmony, a resourceful state. The card indicates a high level of energy. A person is in sync with the flows of light in this world. Hence, here comes a state of spiritual clarity and inner structure. One's life is full of only happy events and good people. There is enough energy for all the necessary things. Any undertakings are going to take off and develop according to the best scenario. The World card contains the Nine of Cups, the Nine of Swords and the Nine of Pentacles — high-vibration love, total acceptance, the flow. This is a good, beautiful, stable state. However, human nature doesn't let the person stay in it for a long time, as there are mood swings happening from time to time as well as negative traits that often take over. The more the person strives to return to the state of Peace (World), the more fulfilled and harmonious they feel.
Also, a similar state can occur during an easy, healthy pregnancy.
direct.advice: Get into the state of Peace. Now you can reach and stay in it. Find your inner contact with high vibrations. Meditation, listening to music, and other tools that work for you can help. If the question is about the future, then you need to wait for the state of inner harmony and act out of it.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Мир: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: A person is still in a state of inner harmony, but starts losing it. Something knocked them out of their resourceful state. Most often, it's the fault of one of the Nines: there was not enough inner love or total acceptance from another person, something shook one's confidence in the world, fears appeared. If you track down negative patterns and work on them, you can still have high energy.
reversed.advice: Try to move from negative vibrations into a state of peace and harmony. If the question concerns something that is done out of resentment, grief, revenge, then the card advises not to do so. In this situation, you lack trust, acceptance, or love.

direct.short: Архетип Звезда: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
First meaning
The highest meaning in significant esoteric spreads: call, intuition. It is an inner feeling of irrational, intuitive attraction to something. A person feels the desire they can't explain logically at first. Later, they start looking for the arguments to explain it with their mind, but the inner feeling is primary. The call works at the level of such high vibrations that a person may not be even aware of it. They only feel the desire to do something and understand that they have to follow this feeling. The call always leads in the right direction and supports creation. But sometimes, to create something new, one has to destroy something old. The person feels it is time for changes, fulfilling wishes, so they quit their job, cut old ties. They always have a good reason to act like this.

Second meaning
The lowest meaning in specific, everyday matters: low self-esteem that provokes unnatural behavior. A person is trying to pretend to be someone they are not. They can also be too active making a lot of unnecessary fuss. This is an unconscious attempt to compensate for inner insecurity. It looks fake and only creates distrust.
direct.advice:
First meaning
Follow the call, it will bring important events into your life.

Second meaning
Don't behave like that. You think that it will help you to achieve what you want, but in fact it looks unnatural. Work on your self-esteem.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Звезда: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:
First meaning
The highest meaning in significant esoteric spreads: resistance to the call. A person hears it, but can't explain it with their mind, so they talk themselves out of following it. They either decide that it is not the time, or try to change the conditions and replace the call with an alternative option. But the energy was given to complete a certain task, so they lose their motivation soon and face difficulties.

Second meaning
The lowest meaning in specific, everyday matters: low self-esteem that comes out as arrogance. A person considers themselves better than others, asserts themselves at their expense, keeps distance and doesn't want to cooperate. Everyone can behave like this when it comes to certain matters. Such behavior stems from lack of confidence.
reversed.advice:
First meaning
Stop resisting, follow your intuition.

Second meaning
Realize the moments when you behave arrogantly and try to fix such behavior. Do not cut ties with other people as it seems they are not able to understand you — often this is not the case.

direct.short: Архетип Семерка Жезлов: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
First meaning
Conversations. In esoteric spreads, these are conversations that bring a person closer to realizing their potential. When one talks about something important and meaningful, they put energy into it, which materializes their intention in the real world. This is a natural stage of talking about your plans when it is too early to act. If you do not mull it over and speak it to the end, you may not get a complete picture of what is happening, get lost in your desires and eventually realize you had to act differently. In non-esoteric, everyday matters, the card means a constructive conversation. In relationships and work, it advises to find out something, clarify, discuss. The outcome depends on how people manage to talk with each other and what they decide.

Second meaning
The specific aspect in particular questions: a word. Perhaps you need to pay attention to a specific word that you use in your work or communication. For example, replace a word in an ad, slogan, text. It could also be that a misunderstood word said earlier offended another person.

Third meaning
Another specific aspect: gossip. One is drowning in conversations, reports, and wrong judgments.
Choose the meaning of the card that fits your question best.
direct.advice: Talk, clarify any unclear points. Constructive conversations will be the key to success in your case.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Семерка Жезлов: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: A person avoids conversations because they don't believe in their success. Perhaps, they have already brought up this topic but did not achieve the desired result and gave up. However, the situation requires conversations, and this card suggests they bear fruit. The situation is not hopeless if you choose the right time and appropriate tone for communicating. The conversation might not lead to the result you expect, but it sure will be beneficial fate-wise.
reversed.advice: Don't walk away from the conversation. Talk the situation over with an interlocutor in order to come up with a common solution.

direct.short: Архетип Влюбленные: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
The card has 2 meanings. You can identify which one applies by the nature of your question, or use a clarifying spread.

First meaning
A choice. When a soul comes into this world, it has two programs: a personal one — the tasks and lessons that the higher self has planned to go through in this life, and a social one — rules, social status, relationships with people. The realization of the personal program gives a feeling of being in the right place, satisfaction, joy of life. The social program provides opportunities, material abundance, and belonging to society. One feels happy and fulfilled when both programs are realized. However, the personal program is more important — this is the path to go all the way down, regardless of the circumstances. At different life stages, different programs and areas come to the forefront. At such moments, destiny forces a person to make a choice.
One of the options is always in favor of the social program — it is convenient, profitable, and approved. The second option can't be explained by logic but the heart is drawn to it as this is the right option, the realization of a personal program. The choice between them is a kind of test that allows a person to understand where they are and what is more important for them: the path of the heart or the outer image. At a crossroads, they can make a decision only on their own. A choice is often not obvious and very difficult to make. If one decides to follow their inner voice and the path of the heart, they make the right choice and pass the test. After that, the Chariot card comes to them — new opportunities, realization, success. If they make the wrong choice, the Tower card follows — everything obsolete and unnecessary is being destroyed.

Second meaning
The specific aspect in esoteric spreads: love under the Major Arcana. This is love given from above so that the soul can experience high vibrations. It comes to mature, highly developed souls that are ready to learn significant lessons. This love does not imply anything but pure feelings, without a desire to possess a person, start a relationship, get married, without any expectations and demands. The lesson of high love means that a person knows how to separate love and dependence. There is only a strong feeling that unites two people into a single whole and never ends even if they do not see each other. In most cases, love under the Major Arcana has social limitations and difficulties (concerning religion, age, status). In this spread, The Lovers also mean a choice — to choose hard love only for the sake of feelings or to give it up because it's more convenient. This is an extremely rare meaning of the card.
direct.advice:
First meaning
Make a choice with your heart. Choose the truth — what your inner voice tells you, no matter how difficult it may seem.

Second meaning
A choice where one of the options is correct and the other is not. The choice to be made with the heart. The choice between the path of the heart and the path of the mind.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Влюбленные: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: A person does not make a choice and puts off making a decision in order to see how things will turn out. It seems that it will be more clear which path to choose then. In this situation, they are trying to walk along two different roads at the same time keeping both options open. However, there's no point in doing that — it won't get any easier and you will still have to make a choice. The longer one waits, the more difficult it will be to decide.
reversed.advice: Do not delay making a decision. Opt for something now, otherwise, it will be even more difficult later.

direct.short: Архетип Семерка Пентаклей: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description: Financial energy. There are more money matters in this situation than it seemed initially. This is a favorable card in terms of work and profit. It promises big money. However, when it comes to purchases and expenses, one might spend more than expected. In the spreads about health and character, the card means strong personal energy, vitality and stamina. If the question concerns relationships, the card is unfavorable: one of the partners has a flaw that the second one cannot accept. This negative personality trait is so significant that they will end up either breaking up or drifting apart. In any matters related to relationships and emotions, this meaning can be interpreted as "everything is good, except for one thing."
direct.advice: Work-wise — earn money, make a profitable investment. You definitely have an opportunity to do this now. Health-wise: do something that will give you energy and strength. Relationship-wise: admit that there is a flaw in your partner or you, accept it and think about what to do to come to terms with it if it's possible.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Семерка Пентаклей: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:
First meaning
Difficulties with harnessing the energy that is coming into life. In the spreads about money: a person can't cope with a new financial level, and as a result, they waste money and lose their job. Another option is when people get star-struck, waste money, brag about their position since subconsciously it is unnatural for them. In a relationship, the card stirs up a feeling that this is an uncomfortable level for a person, which they don't deserve. That can often become a reason that people unintentionally provoke conflicts, jealousy, nagging in order to prove their innocence to themselves. As for work, a person either does not cope with their duties or is certain they will fail anyway. Therefore, they subconsciously create situations in which they have to give up, leave. However, the Seven of Pentacles means that now you have all the chances to master a new level and deal with whatever comes into your life. It is not external factors, but your own patterns and blocks that stand in your way.
If the transition to a new level has occurred recently, the card may mean a temporary feeling of confusion that will disappear soon, and a person will get used to the flow of abundance.

Second meaning
The specific aspect in particular issues: tears. They can become a way to release tension when one isn't ready to accept the situation.
reversed.advice: Don't let your negative experience from the past guide you. Relax and accept what comes to you. You can handle it. To better harness your energy, you can do breathing practices or relaxation rituals.

direct.short: Архетип Тройка Жезлов: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description: A successful investment that will bring desired results in the future. A process that started recently leads to success. It is favorable in terms of social status, increases your social value as well as makes external processes more comfortable. Work-wise, this can mean a considerable improvement in working conditions and commute, an increase in comfort, or career growth. As for relationships, the card means a step towards improving the external component: how partners communicate, how they interact, their actions towards one another. These can be the right steps taken together or mutual agreements. The card promises success in all body and health procedures. The character of a person gets more adaptive, allowing them to better show themselves in life.
direct.advice: Take the right steps that will open up new prospects for you. If you continue to invest in this process, you will get what you want.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Тройка Жезлов: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:
An unsuccessful investment that will not bring the desired result. Not realizing what they are doing, a person invests in something that won't be crowned with success. Or the result will be less impressive than expected.
In a relationship, the card can mean that your actions won't influence your partner the way you want them to.
reversed.advice: Give up this undertaking, you are just wasting your energy.

direct.short: Архетип Император: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description: The right actions from the point of view of destiny. A person starts doing something that will eventually lead them in the right direction. The card symbolizes the moment of getting on the right path, so it concerns recent actions, thoughts, and plans. However, it does not promise that everything will turn out exactly the way the person imagines or that they will get what they want. These can be unpleasant events that are favorable anyway from the point of view of higher powers.
direct.advice: Choose evidently right actions that will lead you to your destiny. Deep inside you know what to do.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Император: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: Leaving the path of doing the right things. A person is thinking about or has already started doing the wrong things from the point of view of destiny. They may seem more logical and favorable in the short run but actually do not fit into the destiny of a person. Therefore, they will face obstacles and difficulties on their way.
reversed.advice: Stop, you are moving away from the path of your destiny, going in the wrong direction.

direct.short: Архетип Девятка Мечей: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
First meaning
Deep acceptance. This is the highest level of thinking, perception of events and life in general, the result of a long development of the mind. First, destiny teaches a person to be in sync with the Seven of Swords: to create their own reality, take responsibility, make plans and realize them. Then it gets them through the Eight of Swords, when everything does not go according to plan and the proven methods do not work anymore. If the person learns these lessons, they reach the level of the Nine of Swords. It is an understanding that not everything in the world can be controlled since there are other factors. There is destiny, there is God's will. The person knows that a lot depends on them: they know how to act, take responsibility, try and achieve. But at the same time, they realize that there can be any result, that's why there is no point in holding on to it. So, one accepts any course of events and admits that there is a higher purpose behind it — this is how it should be.

Second meaning
The second meaning in specific questions: it's meant to be. What was meant to happen is happening now. These events are inevitable because of the actions of the people involved. They created this turn of life themselves.
direct.advice:
First meaning
Perceive events at the highest level of thinking. Do whatever depends on you and be as it may.

Second meaning
Accept it as it is your destiny.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Девятка Мечей: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:
First meaning
One can't accept what is happening. There occur difficult, unfair events that totally confuse one's way of thinking at the level of the Nine of Swords. This is an inevitable path to acceptance that must be taken.

Second meaning
The second meaning in specific questions: it's not meant to be. Due to some actions, this path is not available for you now. Perhaps, if you change your behavior, it can become possible again after some time.
reversed.advice:
First meaning
Try to accept what is happening. Work with acceptance.

Second meaning
Accept that it is not meant to happen at this stage.

direct.short: Архетип Императрица: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
The card is responsible for the significant tasks of physical life — relationships between people, romantic and child-parent relationships, childbirth, procreation. At this moment in life, destiny wants a person to take actions to reveal and discover themselves within a certain gender: to become a more feminine woman or a more masculine man. This is necessary to solve the problems that are more suitable for each gender, according to the Empress. Women focus on relationships, and men — on work and fulfillment. In these areas, it is easier for them to achieve their goals, feel the energy flow, understand what is happening and choose further steps.
Therefore, the Empress believes that a woman's task is to develop relationships and take them to a new level. To invest in a man in order to open up herself through interaction with him, increase her feminine energy, sexuality and inner strength. It is important to learn how to get in contact with a man, have a nice conversation, and choose favorable conditions for him. This card can guide a woman through different relationships, so that she gets experience of communication and interaction with men, gains wisdom and karma to meet the man she needs. The Empress is especially supportive of pregnant women. As for men, she wants them to take the family to a new social level providing everything for its harmonious development. The Empress sends him money, necessary information, career growth so that he can use them for the good of the family, or think about starting it, and plan for the future. A man is usually guided by a woman but it is also important for him to invest in their relationship, cooperate and communicate.
The Empress encourages a humane attitude to the world, kindness to all its inhabitants, nature, and actions that will do people good. And vice versa — she nips everything that harms other living beings, their development and life in the bud. In work matters, this card means a fair attitude to people: caring for employees, creating good conditions for colleagues, attention to customers, good manners.
direct.advice: Invest your energy in the current task, do what the Empress expects of you. Its appearance in the spread implies that this is something important that needs to be developed. For women — open up, activate feminine energy, behave more like a woman, direct your attention to your relationship. For men — focus on your family and people around you, invest your resources into them. In matters concerning any interactions with people, the card recommends a friendly attitude, politeness, and care.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Императрица: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: Going against the Empress. Actions that harm relationships or one's development within their gender. It can be an attempt to escape from relationship problems, acting meanly or lying to each other. A woman can anger the Empress if her behavior humiliates a man, and points out that he is not brave enough and is not capable of anything. When, instead of a constructive dialogue, she prefers to distance herself and solve everything on her own. For a man, the reversed Empress can appear if he avoids relationships for a long time, or gives his family little attention and invests his resources into anything but his family. Also, she punishes for disrespectful attitudes towards women and casual dating.
reversed.advice: Fix what the Empress does not like. Analyze your actions and find out how you made her angry — it is not too late to change everything.

direct.short: Архетип Умеренность: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
First meaning
The process of ripening. From the outside, it may seem that nothing is happening but in reality, there is a slow, smooth movement. Events follow each other almost imperceptibly. There is steady development. Maybe one is going through a process of internal preparation. The person should not worry about the feeling of stagnation and silence, as their fears are unfounded — everything moves at its own pace.

Second meaning
The specific aspect in questions concerning relationships: natural partnership. Two people complement each other perfectly in all aspects of life. This is a good card for friendship and business cooperation. But if the question is about a romantic relationship, a couple might have lost passion and spark. Their relationship revolves around family, life, children, but not each other.
direct.advice:
First meaning
Keep doing what you did and wait. Let the events take their course. Now is not the time for active action and ventures.

Second meaning
Be in a natural partnership. Try to bring new emotions into your relationship with your loved one.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Умеренность: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:
First meaning
It is time for active action. Now the process of ripening and assimilation is replaced by a period of growth, development, dynamics, and major changes. One can already see the first results.

Second meaning
Specific aspect in questions concerning relationships: resistance to the natural partnership. Instead of uniting, people fight, argue, create a conflict of interests.
reversed.advice:
First meaning
Take action, start new processes, develop old ones, make changes and adjustments.

Second meaning
Reach a consensus and restore the natural partnership. Together you will achieve much more impressive results.

direct.short: Архетип Восьмерка Кубков: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description: Feeling lost, confused. A person tries to get clarity and a better understanding of the situation but they do not succeed. They want to divide everything into good and bad, but already notice the diversity of the world, advantages and disadvantages. It is difficult for them to define the status, role, attitude, put a clear label, see things in black and white. It feels hard, incomprehensible and uncomfortable. However, the Eight of Cups is a card of wisdom. It does not force you to make a quick decision. This is an important period of development you need to experience in order to learn to see all the aspects of life and accept them.
direct.advice: Be in the wisdom card. Realize all the advantages and disadvantages and learn to think wider. It is not necessary to decide something or set clear borders now.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Восьмерка Кубков: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: A person resists, struggles with themselves, tries to get clarity. They are always tense, trying to make a choice but nothing comes of it.
reversed.advice: You want to see things in black and white but it is impossible in the current situation — it is neither good nor bad. Learn wisdom and acceptance.

direct.short: Архетип Королева Кубков: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
First meaning
The Queen of Cups of the woman that the question is about. In this meaning it is connected with the zodiac sign according to the Western horoscope. Cups are a suit of people born under the water signs — Cancer, Scorpio, Pisces. Thus, if the woman belongs to one of these three signs and you know about it, then the card can have this meaning. If she belongs to another sign, or you do not know her sign of the zodiac, then it's not the case — look for the answer in the second or third meaning.
The Queen of Cups represents a woman as she is, with her own strengths and weaknesses, peculiarities, individual qualities. This is a "home" card, as if you are at home. It allows you to be your true self, and in this situation it is favorable. In this job, in this relationship, in this place, you are needed just the way you are. But one has to understand that both positive and negative traits come to the surface. The card does not judge: depending on the context of your question, merits or demerits will play a bigger role. If there is a choice between two options in the spread, and there appears the Queen of Cups, the cards say: no matter what advice we give, you will still do it your way.

Second meaning
Describes the character of a woman. It has no connection with the zodiac sign. The Queen of Cups means emotionalism, high sensitivity. For such people, feelings are the main language of communication. They act out of emotions, they are deeply immersed in their feelings. They can be divided into two types. The first is bright, happy women who love to attract attention. They get interested and fall in love quite easily, often embellishing their stories to express their deep feelings. The second type is sensitive, romantic women. They experience deep emotions, are very sensitive and thoughtful. It is important for the Queen of Cups to always feel emotions. When there are no positive emotions, she can provoke negative ones — scandals, conflicts. She may be prone to freak out, be in character or a drama queen, manipulate people.
The card describes general traits of character but each person is individual and shows themselves in their own way.
Also, the card can refer to a woman who does not fit this description but behaved like the Queen of Cups in a particular situation. This can be when she is in love, full of emotions and extremely sensitive.

Third meaning
A drinking person. Someone with a drinking problem. The answer to the question lies either in this person or in their addiction.
direct.advice:
First meaning
Be yourself. This is exactly what you need to do in this situation.

Second meaning
Be the Queen of Cups. Let yourself feel and express your emotional side.

Third meaning
Overcome alcohol addiction before it causes serious problems.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Королева Кубков: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:
First meaning
Showing your worst personality traits. In this situation, a woman revealed some of her major flaws, and that had a negative effect on her life.

Second meaning
The Queen of Cups is offended. The reaction to the offense depends on the personality traits. The woman can make a scene and throw a tantrum, or she can burst into tears and leave. She will feel deeply hurt and unconsciously adjust her mood to this feeling.
Also, the card can refer to a woman who does not fit this description but behaved like the Queen of Cups in a particular situation.

Third meaning
Disruptive behavior when one is drunk. A person drank too much and did something bad, made a scandal, broke the law.
reversed.advice:
First meaning
Try not to do this. Work it out, learn to control yourself because it hinders you. If the question is about the future, then some situation will trigger your worst qualities, so try to escape it if possible.

Second meaning
Most often the cards advise to react more calmly, not to take offense and make scandals. But sometimes they may recommend that you act emotionally when it is necessary to spice things up in the relationship. The meaning depends on the question and the context of the situation.

Third meaning
Don't do this and overcome alcohol addiction.

direct.short: Архетип Шестерка Жезлов: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
First meaning
The social area where there is stability and, at the same time, a creative component. Work-wise, this means stability, status, as well as creating something new, contributing yourself. In a relationship, the card implies a certain status and area of responsibility but also respect for the freedom and interests of a partner, flexible agreements. As for character, it means all-around development, the ability to show yourself in different situations. The Six of Wands symbolizes a higher standard of living, the ability to give yourself to processes and enjoy them.

Second meaning
A slow movement towards a goal. This can be good if slow steps are important for the process, but unfavorable if the movement is too slow, or it is just a simple statement of fact. To understand, you should look at the other cards in the spread, or ask the cards clarifying questions.
direct.advice:
First meaning
Create a comfortable social environment by reinforcing the part that is missing. If you need more stability, establish rules and agreements. If you lack creativity, come up with new suggestions, your own solutions. The card says that you can definitely do it.

Second meaning
Keep moving. If the pace is important for the process, try to speed up and reach your goal faster.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Шестерка Жезлов: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: Bad experience of the past makes it difficult to assess the situation accurately. A person subconsciously expects that events will play out like similar scenarios, and draws conclusions based on that. Thus, it might delude the person not allowing them to use opportunities and act appropriately. The card promises neither a better nor a worse outcome, but it assures that everything will turn out differently.
reversed.advice: Do not compare the current situation with the past. Act from the present moment.

direct.short: Архетип Рыцарь Мечей: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
The card has three meanings. You can understand which of them fits your situation by the question, or do clarifying spreads.

First meaning
The development of the situation that stems from the Page of Swords. There have been changes in one's perception, assessment of the situation, beliefs, worldview. One already has a general idea of what's happened and understands that these changes are for the better. What was just a general intention turned into a real plan. It can still develop, undergo some changes, but on the whole it is worked out and clear.

Second meaning
Argument, conflict of opinions. There was a conflict between two people with different points of view. Each is trying to convince the other, impose their own opinion and prove their point. It is not a constructive dialogue when it is important to understand the other person's opinion. The dispute can be quite emotional or calm but the main thing here is the topic of the argument, while emotions are secondary.

Third meaning
The card has its third meaning when the question concerns people: it is connected with the zodiac sign of a person that the question is about (according to the Western zodiac). Swords are a suit of people born under the Earth signs — Virgo, Capricorn, Taurus. Thus, if a person belongs to one of these three signs and you know about it, then the card can have the third meaning. If they belong to another sign, or you do not know their sign of the zodiac, then it's not the case — look for the answer in the first or second meaning.
In the third meaning, the card refers to a man or woman of the Earth signs of the zodiac, whose behavior contradicts generally accepted social roles in the society. This is the man who does not behave like a man, or the woman who does not behave like a woman. The card can also speak of a relationship where the man's actions are childish, and he is often indecisive and weak. Or about a woman who is quite rude and not feminine. That is, a person's behavior is unpleasant and not approved in terms of gender roles. It does not fit into the idea of how a man should behave and/or how a woman should behave. Most often it concerns a specific situation when a person behaves this way.
The card can also speak of a child born under an Earth zodiac sign. It is a statement of fact: the child is somehow connected with what you are asking about.
direct.advice:
First meaning
Draw conclusions, analyze the situation and correct it if necessary.

Second meaning
Have a constructive dialogue to get a better understanding of the issue. Try to listen to other people's opinions and resolve this conflict.

Third meaning
The card advises not to behave in such a way.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Рыцарь Мечей: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:
The card has three meanings. You can understand which of them fits your situation by the question, or do clarifying spreads.

The first and second meanings coincide with the meaning of the Knight of Swords in the upright position.

Third meaning
It is also linked to the Earth signs of the zodiac (Virgo, Capricorn, Taurus). The meaning coincides with the upright Knight of Swords, but their "not masculine" or "not feminine" behavior was a one-time thing, while the reversed card says it's typical of a person. It is inherent in their character, as a negative side of their personality. If the question was about a child, the card means the child who shows the worst qualities of their personality.
reversed.advice: Try to notice similar traits in your personality and correct them.

direct.short: Архетип Колесо Фортуны: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
Transition to a new level. The card indicates the transitional process that will definitely lead to a significant improvement of the situation. At first, one can feel uncomfortable because of these changes and sped-up events. Sometimes, it might seem that nothing is happening outwardly, but qualitatively the situation is getting more favorable (for example, your attitude or inner perception improves). The card comes when a person completes the current level of development and is ready to go to the higher one. It often goes hand in hand with social growth — promotion at work, getting some material benefits. Also, the card can speak about spiritual growth through powerful processes.
If a person is going through a rough patch right now, and there is Wheel of Fortune in the spread, then destiny wants to quickly remove their negative karma before they move to a higher level. There it will have a detrimental effect on the person's life, so it is better to get rid of it now.
direct.advice: Take action. Move forward even if it is uncomfortable — Wheel of Fortune is taking you to the next level. Don't miss its powerful influence.
