If the question is about the future, wait for Wheel of Fortune to deal with it. You will get more stability, experience, resources, a higher status, so you will manage to cope with the situation.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Колесо Фортуны: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: Almost coincides with the upright meaning of Wheel of Fortune, however here a person has a choice — to use it or not. One might not notice the opportunities that come into their life: new information, offers. How the person will react and what they will do depends only on them. Refusal to act won't have negative consequences but if you ignore Wheel of Fortune several times in a row, it can lead to bad karma.
reversed.advice: Take up the opportunities that turn up in your life. Don't give up on them.

direct.short: Архетип Солнце: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
The perfect harmony of the external and internal. Requests, desires and the character of a person fit perfectly into external circumstances. There emerge the right circumstances for the person to be their true self. The person gets what they asked for, so the Sun can be called a card of happiness. In terms of character, the card speaks of a well-balanced personality that doesn't have a lot of internal contradictions.
The negative side of this card is that it is unstable and short-term as well as depends a lot on the circumstances. Any changes, either external or internal, will destroy the harmony. Desires and priorities are changing.
In terms of relationships, the card indicates the person one can create a family with. In spite of the changing circumstances, it's highly likely that the couple will manage to maintain and strengthen their relationship.
direct.advice: You have everything you need to fulfill your wishes. Take the necessary steps to achieve the perfect harmony.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Солнце: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:
Fixing negative karma. A person does everything right but some time ago they created negative karma, that's why they cannot see any results of their actions yet. They are doing their best but it doesn't pay because everything is focused on balancing their karma. Only when it turns into a plus, they will see all the results and benefits they got and realize that their wishes have come true. For example, the person has been long hesitating whether to take the opportunity to set up their own business, and that subtracted from their karma. As a result, they finally made up their mind and started a business, but it is not thriving and does not make a profit. There is the process of fixing negative karma. If the person does not give up and keeps on trying, then they will get everything they want in the end — behind the reversed Sun there always hides success. But it is impossible to say how long it will take to achieve it. You have to believe in it.
In terms of relationships, there might be the potential for their development. But for this you need to go through a rough patch together, to adapt to each other if necessary. If people invest in their relationship and do their best, eventually they will find their happiness.
As for character, the person has to do a lot of inner work on themselves in order to start showing their true self in a more harmonious way. Perhaps there are a lot of traumas and complexes to deal with.
reversed.advice: Keep acting and investing your energy. This process definitely has real potential, it just takes time.

direct.short: Архетип Тройка Пентаклей: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description: A new process began some time ago, and it has already brought some results. Or, a new stage of an old process has begun, which is already bearing fruit. It's time to draw conclusions and make further plans on their basis. In a relationship, it is now clear how a new beginning manifests itself. One can notice what influence the new process has on their character. The time to correct actions and choose a further path has come.
direct.advice: You already know where this process is leading you. Draw conclusions and plan the next steps.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Тройка Пентаклей: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: A person puts off drawing conclusions as they feel they won't like them. They refuse to plan further actions in the hope that the result will change over time. This behavior is more typical of a child who waits out an unpleasant situation and hopes for a good outcome for no reason.
reversed.advice: Accept the truth. This will allow you to see things clearly and consider further actions carefully.

direct.short: Архетип Двойка Пентаклей: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
First meaning
The emergence of options that don't seem perfect. A person has different opportunities but they don't like any of them. It can be confusing and one doesn't know what to think about what is coming into their life and how to deal with it. The card means that the person does not have a full picture of what they want. They can't prioritize, so they are torn between different options.

Second meaning
The specific aspect in matters relating to documents, contracts: mixed up documentation that can lead to problems.
direct.advice: Channel your energy into the thoughts about what you really want. Decide what matters most to you. You can also find a "model" that is close to your idea of perfection so that you use it to visualize your goal better.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Двойка Пентаклей: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: Unfinished tasks that make one a fate's debtor. These are unpleasant things that a person does not like, so they avoid them, postpone until the last moment. They pile up and over time can develop into a karmic knot, which will cause real problems. It may also mean that in this matter something is not ready yet and needs working on.
reversed.advice: Finish what you have been postponing for a long time. Do not delay — fate will still force you to learn these lessons but at a higher cost.

direct.short: Архетип Двойка Кубков: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description: Love, enchantment. This is a good card that describes the beginning of a relationship, when your heart beats faster, a partner seems perfect and all your thoughts are about them. If the question does not concern romantic relationships, then the card means enchantment, being "on the same wavelength" with a person, city, job, some significant thing. In such a situation, everything seems to be perfect and you feel like you have everything you have ever dreamed of. Also, the card can mean an inner feeling of self-satisfaction, pride in your actions. However, the card isn't deep — it describes a short emotional period but does not promise its development into more serious feelings. It is characterized by illusions, lack of awareness, actions led by emotions.
direct.advice: Enjoy the moment, let yourself have this wonderful experience, but do not confuse it with deeper feelings.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Двойка Кубков: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: Fighting and arguing over meaningless things. Their reason lies in inner complaints and hurt feelings that accumulated over time, and a person is not even aware of their existence. It can also be inner dissatisfaction, excessive criticism and high expectations of yourself.
reversed.advice: Deal with your inner complaints, speak and work them out — they are the reasons for your conflicts.

direct.short: Архетип Девятка Пентаклей: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
The right actions from the point of view of the mission, which provides a high level of energy and money. Although the energy flow is not as powerful as at the Seven of Pentacles, there is exactly as much energy as needed. One has enough energy for all their undertakings, it comes in and distributes evenly among the things that have to be done. At this level, the person almost never feels a lack of energy, there is no need to recharge the batteries. In terms of health, it means wellness.
There may be less money at the Nine of Pentacles than at the Seven, but the quality and standard of living is definitely higher due to other things that can't be bought. Money comes in for specific tasks and exactly as much as needed. The person gets the rest with the help of other resources, gifts, prizes, connections.
In general, the level of the Nine of Pentacles implies living in the flow. When the person listens to the higher powers and works for them, their intuition is well-developed, and they enjoy a whirlwind of good events. Everything works out well, and one knows how to make the best out of things.
In a relationship, the card means true partnership. A couple have similar life values, worldview, approximately the same energy level and emotional state. People can be different, but they are perfect for each other at all levels. The card says the couple have perfect relationships now. They resonate like true partners.
direct.advice: Be in the flow. Keep on acting and making your life better, now there are favorable circumstances for it. Trust your feelings. Do what gives you energy. In terms of relationship, be in true partnership, open yourself up to it.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Девятка Пентаклей: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:
The wrong distribution of energy and money. A person begins to invest themselves into something new and suddenly faces some problems. The energy was given for one thing, but they got distracted and directed it into something else, so they got disconnected from the flow. For example, one was planning to set up a business, but when they finally had resources for this, they decided to renovate their house. In money matters, it can be financial help to the people who were not supposed to be helped: destiny taught them important lessons with the aid of money, but the person interfered and got cut off from the resource flow.
Also, the card can mean the appearance of a "causal vampire" in one's life: these are processes, things or people that take time, energy and money. The person wastes their resources and gets nothing in return. Such activities imply no development, movement, or exchange of energy. It can be a formal communication you waste your time on because it would be impolite to refuse to talk. Or hobbies that distract from real life.
In relationships, the reversed Nine of Pentacles is a potential true partner. People can reach this level, but they still need to grow, work, and take steps towards the goal together. It may lead to the fact that one of the partners feels they are perfect for each other, invests in their relationship, but their efforts don't seem to pay off. They expect development and positive changes, but in the end there is only hope and false expectations.
reversed.advice: Stop, you are going in the wrong direction. You are putting your energy and money into the wrong processes. If there is a "causal vampire", get rid of them — they are taking away your resources. When it comes to relationships, try to set a deadline for investing as much as possible and try to take the relationship to the next level. Then draw your conclusions. If there are no changes, end this relationship — it will not lead to a perfect partnership.

direct.short: Архетип Паж Пентаклей: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
There are some changes in the areas of energy or money, which brings new opportunities. The card does not say whether these changes are for the better or worse, it only indicates their beginning. Any changes bring opportunities, but it depends only on a person whether they will notice and seize them. As for relationships, the card says that the energy, the heat in the relationship, and the involvement of partners began to change.
There might be a cool-off period or, vice versa, an increase in interest. In matters of work, the card often promises a change in the financial situation, either for the better or for the worse. In the spreads about health, it says that strength and energy states of the body are changing. Also, the Page of Pentacles can show a change in how much a person puts their soul into a process, how interested they are in the results of their actions.
In esoteric spreads, the card might refer to the power of the project — its expansion, strengthening at the energy level, even when it hasn't brought any financial results yet.
direct.advice: Put your strength and energy into the process you are asking about. Whatever the changes are, they will bring new opportunities. Try to notice them and use them to your advantage.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Паж Пентаклей: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: The meaning coincides completely with the Page of Pentacles in the upright position.
reversed.advice: Обратите внимание на скрытые сомнения и не форсируйте результат.

direct.short: Архетип Трансформация (Смерть): внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description: Pause, silence, all the processes are slowing down. In regards to the question, there is now a calm period without any significant events. The card is similar to the Hermit card, however the Hermit implies a pause created by the Higher Powers to move to a new level, while Death means a pause aimed at solving internal problems. Destiny waits for a person to make a choice that will determine the further development of events. They need to understand what they want. It's not necessary to describe the ideal future in detail. The main thing here is to figure out what things you want to have in your future and which ones you don't. They are formed on the basis of past experience. The Death card advises a person to look back at their past experience and divide it into two categories: "I want it to be in my future" and "I do not want it to happen again". This is how one comes up with ideas and an inner plan for the future. Unlike the Hermit, the energy is directed not into direct actions, but into thinking things over and listening to yourself. The card does not promise that everything will be exactly as you wish — destiny takes your opinion into account, so some things may coincide with your desires, but others may not.
direct.advice: You need to be clear about your desires concerning this issue. It is important to understand what you really want and what you don't want. Now is not the time for direct actions, they will not bring any results.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Трансформация (Смерть): время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: A person resists the Death card and does not fulfill the task of fate. They don't think about their desires and priorities. Perhaps, they create unnecessary fuss and activity. A person is waiting for some clues from destiny, where to move and how to act. But now they must express their opinion.
reversed.advice: Think about your future, formulate your desires and plans. Don't rush or take action, it is useless. The appearance of the card means that you have not decided what you want, or you are wrong about something, and you might be delusional. Try to think deeper and be more specific.

direct.short: Архетип Король Пентаклей: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
First meaning
The King of Pentacles of the man that the question is about. In this meaning it is connected with the zodiac sign according to the Western horoscope. Pentacles are a suit of people born under the air signs — Aquarius, Gemini, Libra. Thus, if the man belongs to one of these three signs and you know about it, then the card can have this meaning. If he belongs to another sign, or you do not know his sign of the zodiac, then it's not the case — look for the answer in the second or third meaning.
The King of Pentacles represents a man as he is, with his own strengths and weaknesses, peculiarities, individual qualities. This is a "home" card, as if you are at home. It allows you to be your true self, and in this situation it is favorable. In this job, in this relationship, in this place, you are needed just the way you are. But one has to understand that both positive and negative traits come to the surface. The card does not judge: depending on the context of your question, merits or demerits will play a bigger role. If there is a choice between two options in the spread, and there appears the King of Pentacles, the cards say: no matter what advice we give, you will still do things your way.

Second meaning
Describes the character of a man. It has no connection with the zodiac sign. The King of Pentacles is detached, aristocratic, and keeps himself to himself. Such people prefer to keep their distance, not to get close to anyone or share their thoughts and feelings a lot. They set strong boundaries and do not allow others to cross them. Besides, they are often intelligent and polite, and have good manners. They come across as mysterious, secretive and unapproachable. They might be prone to selfishness, arrogance, excessive coldness. Kings of Pentacles have difficulties in building relationships, and often remain single.
The card describes general traits of character but each person is individual and shows themselves in their own way.
Also, the card can refer to a man who does not fit this description but behaved like the King of Pentacles in a particular situation.

Third meaning
The King is in the flow. This means that a man listens to his intuition and acts on its advice. He makes the right decisions and chooses the right path.
direct.advice:
First meaning
Be yourself. This is exactly what you need to do in this situation.

Second meaning
Be the King of Pentacles. Show your dignity and keep your distance. But sometimes the cards want to show that you are too cold when you don't have to be.

Third meaning
Keep listening to your intuition and acting according to it.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Король Пентаклей: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:
First meaning
Showing your worst personality traits. In this situation, a man revealed some of his major flaws, and that had a negative effect on his life.

Second meaning
The King of Pentacles is offended. The reaction to the offense depends on the personality traits. Most often, he is calm, does not show what hurt him, but makes conclusions and distances himself, disappears from a person's field. After that it is difficult to get close to him again and to earn his forgiveness.
Also, the card can refer to a man who does not fit this description but behaved like the King of Pentacles in a particular situation.

Third meaning
A man does not hear his intuition and acts contrary to it. His actions are wrong, he is not able to grasp the situation and understand what is happening. This can be his typical problem, or a particular period in his life.
reversed.advice:
First meaning
Try not to do this. Learn to control yourself. If the question is about the future, then some situation will trigger your worst qualities, so try to escape it if possible.

Second meaning
Most often cards say that you are being too cold. Don't be distant, be more gentle. But sometimes they advise to leave, not to take part in this matter. The meaning depends on the question and the context of the situation.

Third meaning
Learn to listen to your intuition, develop it.

direct.short: Архетип The Pope (The Hierophant): внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description: New people, situations, and experiences for soul development. These processes teach a person important lessons in terms of destiny. Often, the card stands for the "hierophant union". This is a relationship in which partners must teach each other something important, and pick up all the necessary qualities. Usually, destiny brings together very different, seemingly incompatible people. As a result, irresistible attraction arises between them, and that doesn't allow them to drift apart until they learn their lessons. Such a connection goes hand in hand with tension, difficulties, and constant work on yourself. It's designed to break stereotypes and teach by example of another person that one can live and act differently. Various skills are essential for the soul experience. The Hierophant can symbolize a new relationship, or the beginning of such a life stage when it is important to learn something from each other in a relationship you already have. The hierophant alliance concerns not only romantic relationships, but also any interaction between people which implies learning: a teacher — a student, an employer — an employee, a parent — a child, a more experienced colleague — a less experienced one.
direct.advice: Learn, embrace the experience you are destined to get. Or teach someone else, pass on knowledge that you already have.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект The Pope (The Hierophant): время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: An attempt to leave the hierophant alliance, take an easier path and avoid difficulties. A person gives up important experiences that are necessary for their soul's growth. They are trying to get out of the process without learning lessons of destiny.
reversed.advice: Accept all the necessary lessons and go through them. Do not resist the "hierophant union". If the question doesn't concern any relationships, then the card recommends drawing conclusions, understanding what you need to learn, what emotions to work with, what mistakes to analyze and not to make again.

direct.short: Архетип Тройка Мечей: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description: Ill-conceived ideas, lack of a clear plan. A person overlooked something, so they faced difficulties. Probably, in this situation it was not possible to get all the necessary information, that's why one has to improvise.
direct.advice: Try to think everything over and plan ahead of time. If it is not possible, play it by ear, focusing on the moment.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Тройка Мечей: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: Life full of illusions, fantasies, and delusions. A person refuses to see the truth and take everything as it is, because they do not want to deal with it. They deny the true state of affairs and mix up illusions with reality. The truth is obvious but inconvenient, so it's easier to lie to yourself.
reversed.advice: Accept reality, whatever it is — this is the only way you can move on.

direct.short: Архетип Рыцарь Пентаклей: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
The card has three meanings. You can understand which of them fits your situation by the question, or do clarifying spreads.

First meaning
The development of the situation that stems from the Page of Pentacles. There have been considerable changes in the area of energy and money. A person started investing their energy, which has already brought some results. One can see what it gives and how it will develop in the future. In relationships, it is clear how the atmosphere, the heat in the relationship, and the involvement of partners have changed. In financial matters, it is already clear how much money this process, project or investment will bring, and how the financial situation has changed. As for health, one has a better understanding of their body state and their level of strength and energy.

Second meaning
Narrow-mindedness. In this situation a person does not see all the possible options, but focuses only on a few ones. For example, in their personal life, they are open only to certain ways of meeting new people and developing their relationships with them, and do not even think about others. It has never occurred to them that everything can be different.

Third meaning
The card has its third meaning when the question concerns people: it is connected with the zodiac sign of a person that the question is about (according to the Western zodiac). Pentacles are a suit of people born under the air signs — Aquarius, Gemini, Libra. Thus, if a person belongs to one of these three signs and you know about it, then the card can have the third meaning. If they belong to another sign, or you do not know their sign of the zodiac, then it's not the case — look for the answer in the first or second meaning.
In the third meaning, the card refers to a man or woman of the air signs of the zodiac, whose behavior contradicts generally accepted social roles in the society. This is the man who does not behave like a man, or the woman who does not behave like a woman. The card can also speak of a relationship where the man's actions are childish, and he is often indecisive and weak. Or about a woman who is quite rude and not feminine. That is, a person's behavior is unpleasant and not approved in terms of gender roles. It does not fit into the idea of how a man should behave and/or how a woman should behave. Most often it concerns a specific situation when a person behaves this way.
The card can also speak of a child born under an air zodiac sign. It is a statement of fact: the child is somehow connected with what you are asking about.
direct.advice:
First meaning
Draw conclusions, analyze the situation and correct it if necessary.

Second meaning
You are thinking small and can't see all the possible options. Try to find them, use other sources of information to get advice.

Third meaning
The card advises not to behave in such a way.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Рыцарь Пентаклей: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:

The first and second meanings coincide with the meaning of the Knight of Pentacles in the upright position.

Third meaning
It is also linked to the air signs of the zodiac (Aquarius, Gemini, Libra). The meaning coincides with the upright Knight of Pentacles, but their "not masculine" or "not feminine" behavior was a one-time thing, while the reversed card says it's typical of a person. It is inherent in their character, as a negative side of their personality. If the question was about a child, the card means the child who shows the worst qualities of their personality.
reversed.advice: Try to notice similar traits in your personality and correct them.

At this stage, it gets much more difficult to manage your feelings. Interest turned into infatuation. Resentment grew worse. Apologizing can fix the situation but it won't change the negative feeling deep inside. One feels the atmosphere of space or a group of people differently. It is already clear whether these changes are leading to a positive or negative outcome.

direct.short: Архетип Башня: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
Losses, destruction of the old. There is something that should be left in the past, but a person holds on to it and is not ready to let it go. If so, the Tower comes to them and takes it away by force. One loses their job, breaks up relationships, their valuable possessions disappear, technical devices break down. The Tower always takes only what has already become obsolete and is no longer needed. It cleans up the old and makes room for a new stage that is ready to start.
But the person is not aware of this, so the card feels very painful. One can try to redirect the energy of the Tower to destroy not the process itself, but the circumstances that interfere with it. In a relationship, for example, to remove something that makes people grow apart and go through a rough patch. But resisting the Tower is useless — it will still make room for the new.
Also, the Tower comes to those who made the wrong choice at the Lovers card.
direct.advice: Let the Tower take what it's time to let go from your life. This is an inevitable process of renewal.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Башня: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: A person tries to resist the Tower and hold onto the past at any cost. It's time to let go, to leave, but they want to avoid losses, as they are afraid of changes.
reversed.advice: Relax and give the Tower what no longer belongs to you.

direct.short: Архетип Маг: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description: An idea given from above comes to mind. That idea chose a person to be applied in the world and make it better with their help. They already have everything that is needed to implement that idea. What is missing now will come at the right time. If the person takes everything into their own hands and starts taking action, they will achieve some positive results eventually. People around usually admire a Magician's idea and approve of it. The scope of an idea and an area of life it concerns depend on a question: the card can symbolize a good idea concerning everyday matters or a big idea in important spreads.
direct.advice: Wait for the idea to come to you in the near future. If you already have an idea, implement it — this world needs it, so the space will support you. The decision not to follow the idea won't have any negative consequences but if you put it into action, it will improve your life.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Маг: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: A flawed idea. A person had everything to implement their plans but they happened to ruin everything with their own hands. Perhaps, they removed something important from the idea, added unnecessary details, or talked too much about it. It is also possible that they've been planning for too long, waiting for luck, or directed their attention outwards instead of an implementation process.
reversed.advice: Think about how you could've killed your idea — there is still an opportunity to fix everything and implement it.

direct.short: Архетип Сила: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
First meaning
Strength and energy that is given from above to solve certain problems, external or internal. As for external tasks, Strength comes to help cope with a specific situation. This help can feel like elation, improvement of willpower and organizational skills. Strength's task is to deal with chaos in a situation. For example, when having important negotiations or a difficult dialogue, a person sounds convincing, powerful, and one can feel the energy coming out of them. Others listen to them and never argue, even if they planned to. Strength helps organize complex dynamic processes, systematize and structure them.
As for internal tasks, Strength comes to work on personal processes when it is time for transformation. It creates a strong backbone and helps to go through significant changes in order to reach a new level of development. One can feel this support when it gets easier to organize themselves or do something they did not succeed in before, for what they lacked willpower. Strength leaves the person when they complete the transition and can cope on their own.
Consider your question to understand what tasks you need Strength for, or do clarifying spreads.

Second meaning
The specific aspect in matters that imply this meaning: sex, when it is the highest form of intimacy. People connect spiritually through physical contact. The card either says that you can find an answer in this sphere, or indicates some difficulties in it.
direct.advice:
First meaning
Use Strength to resolve your current issues, external or internal.

Second meaning
Pay attention to the sexual aspect of your life. The appearance of the card indicates that there is potential in it, so you can work on this sphere and improve it.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Сила: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:
First meaning
A person was given Strength to solve specific external tasks but they neither managed to do that, nor used Strength. So, one feels inner discomfort realizing their failure. It often happens because when a person is experiencing Strength, someone hits a nerve, which knocks them out of the flow and takes all the energy. If the question is about future prospects, something can make a person lose the right spirit.
The reversed card never means Strength for solving internal problems. It always speaks of failure in the external situation.

Second meaning
The specific aspect in matters that imply this meaning: some difficulties in the sexual sphere.
reversed.advice:
First meaning
Realize your pressure points in order to work on them. In questions about an upcoming event, try to prepare yourself for a painful situation you'll need to get over. In the moment when you are using Strength, it is important not to get carried away into negative emotions. Try not to lose contact with Strength, go through this moment quickly. You can think about it later, the main thing is not to get out of the flow. You can also learn to take a pause for a few seconds in order to quickly and fully experience an unpleasant situation and move on.

Second meaning
Think how you can improve this aspect of your life. Take active steps in this direction.

direct.short: Архетип Туз Мечей: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description: The emergence of an idea that possesses a person. This idea does not come from above, it is created by the mind, so it may not coincide with the path outlined by fate. The person comes up with a plan that should bring results. The idea can occupy all their thoughts, they want to hit the goal as soon as possible. There's a feeling that achieving it will tackle a lot of life problems. The card does not say whether it's a good idea or not, just states that one is obsessed with it.
direct.advice: Evaluate the feasibility of your idea. Don't obsess over it or shut yourself off from other opportunities. If the question requires willpower and putting in a lot of effort, the card advises you to set a clear goal, make it your priority and strive for achieving it.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Туз Мечей: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:
Losing an idea that seemed very significant. A person was obsessed with their idea, wanted to realize it, but everything collapsed all of a sudden. It is clear now that it was impossible. The card might go hand in hand with a lot of pain, negative emotions and even depression. The reversed Ace of Swords comes up when the idea does not fit into the destiny scenario and does not belong to the higher purpose. Other possible reasons: one rushes things up, sets too many conditions for implementation, or, vice versa, deprives the idea of its sense.
The specific aspect in questions that imply this meaning: pregnancy.

The second aspect: suicide.

The third aspect: studying.
reversed.advice: Come to terms with the fact that it's impossible to put your idea into action now and move on. Perhaps, if you reconsider your conditions for it, it will get easier to implement it.

direct.short: Архетип Девятка Жезлов: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description: Obstacles one has to overcome. Destiny wants a person to make efforts and grow energetically. These obstacles are always surmountable, so there are things that depend entirely on the person, they might be able to influence them. It is time to take action and do your best, then the situation improves and starts moving towards a positive outcome. Sometimes the obstacles seem insignificant, as if they are meant to distract the person from their goal. One realizes they have a lot of small errands to do, which takes all their attention and time. The main thing here is to overcome this impulse and focus on the main thing. If the person passes the test, the Nine of Wands will help them to succeed.
direct.advice: Overcome obstacles. Make an effort and destiny will lead you to a favorable outcome.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Девятка Жезлов: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: Obstacles come up in someone else's life. It can be a family member, friend, acquaintance, often a child or a pet. Something happens to them and that can affect a person's decision, preventing them from doing what they planned. It might happen that a person themselves becomes such an obstacle, when their inner subpersonality is against their decision. In such a situation, it is important not to respond to provocation, though it is often difficult in case of close people.
reversed.advice: Overcome this obstacle. Come to an agreement, find another solution, but finish what you started and reach your goal.

direct.short: Архетип Королева Мечей: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
First meaning
The Queen of Swords of the woman that the question is about. In this meaning it is connected with the zodiac sign according to the Western horoscope. Swords are a suit of people born under the Earth signs — Virgo, Capricorn, Taurus. Thus, if the woman belongs to one of these three signs and you know about it, then the card can have this meaning. If she belongs to another sign, or you do not know her sign of the zodiac, then it's not the case — look for the answer in the second or third meaning.
The Queen of Swords represents a woman as she is, with her own strengths and weaknesses, peculiarities, individual qualities. This is a "home" card, as if you are at home. It allows you to be your true self, and in this situation it is favorable. In this job, in this relationship, in this place, you are needed just the way you are. But one has to understand that both positive and negative traits come to the surface. The card does not judge: depending on the context of your question, merits or demerits will play a bigger role. If there is a choice between two options in the spread, and there appears the Queen of Swords, the cards say: no matter what advice we give, you will still do it your way.

Second meaning
Describes the character of a woman. It has no connection with the zodiac sign. The Queen of Swords means willpower, determination, backbone. Such women know what they want and what needs to be done. They are persistent and goal-oriented, and have good organizational skills. They often have an analytical, "masculine" mind, an ability to see the full picture and draw conclusions. However, they can be feminine, well-groomed, and communicative. They might be prone to be tough, rigorous, and lack feminine nature.
The card describes general traits of character but each person is individual and shows themselves in their own way. Also, the card can refer to a woman who does not fit this description but behaved like the Queen of Swords in a particular situation.

Third meaning
A dark magician. A person who intentionally or unconsciously sends negative energy. They have either the necessary knowledge and skills for this, or such a strong intention that manifests itself in reality. This is an extremely rare meaning that concerns only the spreads about magic.
direct.advice:
First meaning
Be yourself. This is exactly what you need to do in this situation.

Second meaning
Be the Queen of Swords. Pull yourself together, set goals and achieve them. However, in terms of relationships, the card may point out that your behavior is too rude and harsh when it is not necessary.

Third meaning
Protect yourself from the influence of the dark magician.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Королева Мечей: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:
First meaning
Showing your worst personality traits. In this situation, a woman revealed some of her major flaws, and that had a negative effect on her life.

Second meaning
The Queen of Swords is offended. The reaction to the offense depends on the personality traits. A woman can remain silent and stay not to waste her time. However, if she fights back, she does it in a harsh and determined way. She can hold a grudge for a long time, and then take revenge.
Also, the card can refer to a woman who does not fit this description but behaved like the Queen of Swords in a particular situation.

Third meaning
Aggression of a dark magician. Their evil will is directed against a specific person.
reversed.advice:
First meaning
Try not to do this. Work it out, learn to control yourself because it hinders you. If the question is about the future, then some situation will trigger your worst qualities, so try to escape it if possible.

Second meaning
Most often the cards advise neither to succumb to aggression, nor to take revenge.

Third meaning
Protect yourself from the influence of the dark magician.

direct.short: Архетип Справедливость: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
The card has 3 meanings. You can identify which one applies by the nature of your question, or use a clarifying spread.

First meaning
A specific problem in life. It arose because a person was putting off solving some unpleasant tasks and ignored them. As a result, destiny puts them in such a situation when it is no longer possible to hide and run away from these tasks. The problem leads to another, tying the karmic knot. The more the person waits, the more difficult it will be to fix the situation. If they manage to solve the problem of Justice, they will get lots of energy and luck from the Ace of Pentacles.

Second meaning
The specific aspect in the questions concerning official documents: social egregore. When a group of people are united by a common idea, and their joint energy forms an independent unit and starts existing separately. This is how an egregore is born — an energy structure that controls all the processes within a group that formed it. For example, the religious egregore, the egregore of nationality, the social egregore. By doing certain things, people can fit into a particular egregore.
For example, christening, wedding — fitting into the Christian egregore; marriage, signing official papers, contracts — entering the social egregore. Each egregore has special requirements that must be met. When people do the right actions, follow the rules, and bring benefits to their egregore, it supports and shares its energy with them. However, if someone breaks the rules, the egregore shuns them, and there can be problems and difficulties. The conflict with the social egregore leads to problems with state structures and services.

Third meaning
The specific aspect when the meaning fits the question: problems with the law, prison. A person becomes so dangerous for the social egregore that it isolates them with the help of the most powerful tool.
direct.advice:
First meaning
Don't run away from solving the problem. Think about how you can do it. Work on Justice. If you manage to do that, you will enjoy great success.

Second meaning
Follow the rules of the social egregore. Draw up the documents, conclude an agreement, certify signatures — do everything officially and properly.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Справедливость: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:
The card has 2 meanings. You can identify which one applies by the nature of your question, or use a clarifying spread.

First meaning
Feeling like a victim. Instead of solving problems, a person gets lost in their own illusions. They try to absolve themselves of responsibilities and blame someone else: people around, circumstances, the Universe. However, the card says that this position is wrong — the only person who is responsible for everything happening in your life is you.

Second meaning
The specific aspect in matters concerning official documents: unwillingness to enter the social egregore, to do things officially.
reversed.advice:
First meaning
Stop feeling like a victim. Accept your responsibility and deal with your problems.

Second meaning
An attempt to avoid formalities can anger the social egregore or even make it shun you. It is better to act according to its rules, so that the social egregore gives you energy and support.
