direct.short: Архетип Четверка Пентаклей: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description: The minimum level of money and energy. This is the amount of income when one has enough money only for the essentials. A person lives from paycheck to paycheck. The business neither pays off, nor makes a profit. One can't save up money: something happens and they have to spend the saved money, or their income gets even less. In questions about work, the card says that you will not be able to make good money. The minimum energy level implies that you only have energy for basic needs, necessary minimum of tasks and actions. There is no energy left for creativity, joy, pleasure, enjoyment of life. In the spreads about health — the body has neither strength nor energy, it is susceptible to disease. In relationship matters, it means that partners stay together as they are used to each other. Their union is boring, there is no energy, spark, or passion. In an esoteric sense, the Four of Pentacles means that destiny is unhappy with a person, since they are capable of more. The card can characterize a certain period of life, or the whole life.
direct.advice: You do not want to invest energy, so you get only the minimum. Those who wait but do nothing are doomed to a mundane life. If you want everything to change, take action, invest strength and energy — it will pay off, if not in this area, then in another.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Четверка Пентаклей: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: Improving the situation at the energy level. The card shows some positive dynamics: the amount of money increases, its source gets stronger, and the level of energy grows. In a relationship partners start showing more interest in each other, that's a new stage for them. The card is favorable health-wise — the energy of the physical body grows.
reversed.advice: Keep doing the right things and investing your efforts to improve your life. You are on the right track.

direct.short: Архетип Десятка Жезлов: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
First meaning
A more convenient format of external circumstances. It concerns the social component of life: where a person lives, how they work, how different processes happen in their life, their convenience. Work-wise, this can be an improvement in conditions, logistics, format, schedule. It may also mean taking a step up the career ladder. In relationships, the visible part is changing for the better: the atmosphere and behavior, how people communicate with each other, how they interact. Character-wise, the person built a new useful habit, their skills improved.

Second meaning
The specific aspect in questions concerning relationships: family, unit of society, official marriage. To develop your relationship, you need to take a step the society will approve of: stop hiding it, start living together, get married — it depends on the starting point of the relationship. The card advises to change the social format.

Third meaning
The specific aspect in questions about specific objects: the thing you asked about. The cards call the item the Ten of Wands, and other cards in the spread will characterize it.

Fourth meaning
The specific aspect in questions concerning well-being: the physical body. When cards want to describe a body, they call it the Ten of Wands, and other cards in the spread will describe it in more detail.

Fifth meaning
The specific aspect in questions about a purchase: an expensive purchase that changes a person's status in the society. They become an owner of something significant and that changes the way other people see them.
You can understand the meaning of the card with the help of your question — choose the one that fits the meaning.
direct.advice: You have everything to make your life more comfortable. Take a step up.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Десятка Жезлов: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: A person can already behave in a new way, but still does not let themselves do so. There were some positive changes, they got a new status. However, deep down they haven't got used to it yet, so they behave in the old way. It is typical of all people when they switch to another social format. It is important that this period shouldn't take too much time.
reversed.advice: Get used to your new status and change your behavior in accordance with it.

direct.short: Архетип Восьмерка Пентаклей: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
The emergence of a tempting opportunity that will lead a person to their dream. But to seize it, one needs to give up something stable and familiar in life. Such an opportunity comes to the person when deep down they realize they want something different, real, not socially significant (a purpose — not a career, a soulmate — not someone who feels convenient to be with). Destiny sends them this opportunity to check whether they are ready to follow their dream. At the same time, there are no guarantees that everything will work out, anyway one should give up the old first, so the card implies taking a risk. It is not clear whether it will be possible to set up their own business, but one needs to quit their current job right now. No one knows whether a new relationship will work out, but in order to try, one needs to break off the old one.
If the person decides to take a risk and chooses their dream, they show their readiness for a new level. And then, even if this opportunity does not bring results, they will start moving towards the dream.
direct.advice: Think carefully about whether you are willing to take risks. Take a wise decision. The card does not promise that the situation will turn out fine, it only gives you some information. From destiny's point of view, you should not be afraid to follow your dream. But it is up to you anyway.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Восьмерка Пентаклей: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:
A person decides not to follow their dream, and someone else fulfills their dream instead. The opportunity comes to those who are not afraid to take risks, and often they are less worthy of it. The situation undermines the person's ambitions, pride, and makes them regret. It is especially painful in the case of their personal life. This is a lesson of destiny that teaches us to make the right conclusions and take risks next time.
Also, the card can mean the arrival of another opportunity after the one a person refused to take. But now all the fears that made them change their mind will come true. On the way to their dream, the person will have to face all the problems, failures and negative thoughts they imagined. It is going to be a difficult path not everyone can go till the end. But if they do not give up and overcome the obstacles, they will achieve their dream — the card guarantees this.
reversed.advice: Decide whether you are ready to face all the difficulties for the sake of your dream. If not, don't try. But if you are determined to take a chance, then do not look back and go till the end.

direct.short: Архетип Королева Пентаклей: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
First meaning
The Queen of Pentacles of the woman that the question is about. In this meaning it is connected with the zodiac sign according to the Western horoscope. Pentacles are a suit of people born under the air signs — Aquarius, Gemini, Libra. Thus, if the woman belongs to one of these three signs and you know about it, then the card can have this meaning. If she belongs to another sign, or you do not know her sign of the zodiac, then it's not the case — look for the answer in the second or third meaning.
The Queen of Pentacles represents a woman as she is, with her own strengths and weaknesses, peculiarities, individual qualities. This is a "home" card, as if you are at home. It allows you to be your true self, and in this situation it is favorable. In this job, in this relationship, in this place, you are needed just the way you are. But one has to understand that both positive and negative traits come to the surface. The card does not judge: depending on the context of your question, merits or demerits will play a bigger role. If there is a choice between two options in the spread, and there appears the Queen of Pentacles, the cards say: no matter what advice we give, you will still do it your way.

Second meaning
Describes the character of a woman. It has no connection with the zodiac sign. The Queen of Pentacles is detached, aristocratic, and keeps herself to herself. Such people prefer to keep their distance, not to get close to anyone or share their thoughts and feelings a lot. They set strong boundaries and do not allow others to cross them. Besides, they are often intelligent and polite, and have good manners. They come across as mysterious and secretive. They might be prone to selfishness, arrogance, excessive coldness.
The card describes general traits of character but each person is individual and shows themselves in their own way. Also, the card can refer to a woman who does not fit this description but behaved like the Queen of Pentacles in a particular situation.

Third meaning
The Queen is in the flow. This means that a woman listens to her intuition and acts on its advice. She makes the right decisions and chooses the right path.
direct.advice:
First meaning
Be yourself. This is exactly what you need to do in this situation.

Second meaning
Be the Queen of Pentacles. Show your dignity and royal manners, keep your distance. But sometimes the cards want to show that you are too cold when you don't have to be.

Third meaning
Keep listening to your intuition and acting according to it.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Королева Пентаклей: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:
First meaning
Showing your worst personality traits. In this situation, a woman revealed some of her major flaws, and that had a negative effect on her life.

Second meaning
The Queen of Pentacles is offended. The reaction to the offense depends on the personality traits. Most often, she does not show what hurt her, but makes conclusions and distances herself, disappears from a person's field. After that it is difficult to get close to her again and to earn her forgiveness.
Also, the card can refer to a woman who does not fit this description but behaved like the Queen of Pentacles in a particular situation. For example, when a woman doesn't trust anymore and distances herself from people or a project.

Third meaning
A woman does not hear her intuition and acts contrary to it. Her actions are wrong, she is not able to grasp the situation and understand what is happening. This can be her typical problem, or a particular period in her life.
reversed.advice:
First meaning
Try not to do this. Work it out, learn to control yourself because it hinders you. If the question is about the future, then some situation will trigger your worst qualities, so try to escape it if possible.

Second meaning
Most often cards say that you are being too cold. Close the distance, be more gentle. But sometimes they advise to leave, not to take part in this matter. The meaning depends on the question and the context of the situation.

Third meaning
Learn to listen to your intuition, develop it.

direct.short: Архетип Пятерка Кубков: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description: New knowledge. A new source of valuable information has appeared in the field — something or someone that is more knowledgeable about the topic. This comes in the form of advice, consultation, information read or heard by chance. This knowledge is definitely useful but the card does not guarantee that you will be able to apply it correctly. In the spreads about relationships, the meaning of the card is more complicated. If the situation concerns only one specific area of knowledge, then one of the partners knows it better and helps the other — it's favorable. If the question concerns relationships in general, then one of the partners considers the other as a teacher. Because of this, the relationship misses an important part which is intimacy with a loved one, the energy of love and passion.
direct.advice: Get new knowledge. Ask someone who knows this area for more information. Have a consultation with a specialist. This will give you important knowledge to find the best solution to your problem. You will realize what to focus on to improve the situation.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Пятерка Кубков: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:
First meaning
Blood, kinship. A solution to the problem depends on relatives: their influence, help, arrival or departure. As a rule, the card refers not to spouses, but to close or distant relatives. The second meaning is "like home". The matter will become familiar, understandable and comfortable to the person. Perhaps, not straight away, but they'll like it. In a relationship, partners are close, but there's no passion between them anymore. In relationships with other people, the card means a close contact, a soulmate.
The card is unfavorable in matters of development: a person strives for comfort, and as a result they don't expand their horizon, avoid new experience and progress. In matters of health, it always means blood. It can also have a negative meaning, for example, when it concerns the outcome of a surgery.

Second meaning
The specific aspect in esoteric spreads: the mother of the Kin. This extremely rare meaning points out that the issue involves family programs. Most often it concerns sudden difficulties, unplanned situations. These tasks feel like a burden. It is difficult to solve them but there is an inner feeling that you have to do this.
reversed.advice:
First meaning
Ask your relatives for help, think how their actions can help in your situation. If possible, make yourself feel more comfortable and warm. Make your home cozy and inviting. Let all the conversations be guided by the feeling of closeness and connection. In matters of development, get out of your comfort zone, take new actions for growth.

Second meaning
Solve the problem of the Kin, no matter how difficult it may be. The Kin has chosen you to tackle this issue, so you can definitely deal with it.

direct.short: Архетип Король Кубков: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
First meaning
The King of Cups of the man that the question is about. In this meaning it is connected with the zodiac sign according to the Western horoscope. Cups are a suit of people born under the water signs — Cancer, Scorpio, Pisces. Thus, if the man belongs to one of these three signs and you know about it, then the card can have this meaning. If he belongs to another sign, or you do not know his sign of the zodiac, then it's not the case — look for the answer in the second or third meaning.
The King of Cups represents a man as he is, with his own strengths and weaknesses, peculiarities, individual qualities. This is a "home" card, as if you are at home. It allows you to be your true self, and in this situation it is favorable. In this job, in this relationship, in this place, he is needed just the way he is. But one has to understand that both positive and negative traits come to the surface. The card does not judge: depending on the context of your question, merits or demerits will play a bigger role. If there is a choice between two options in the spread, and there appears the King of Cups, the cards say: no matter what advice we give, you will still do it your way.

Second meaning
Describes the character of a man. It has no connection with the zodiac sign. The King of Cups means emotionalism, high sensitivity. Such people act out of emotions, and are deeply immersed in their feelings. They can be divided into two types. The first one — bright, lively men who love to attract attention, the soul of the party. They know how to present themselves and charm other people, especially women. In relationships, they easily fall for someone, are unstable, but they know how to court women, impress them with romantic gestures. The second type is sensitive, romantic men. They experience deep emotions, are very sensitive and thoughtful. Often such men are engaged in creative activities. This man might be prone either to act out, be too childish and frivolous, or to whine, be too sensitive and vulnerable.
The card describes general traits of character but each person is individual and shows themselves in their own way.
Also, the card can refer to a man who does not fit this description but behaved like the King of Cups in a particular situation.

Third meaning
A drinking person. Someone with a drinking problem. The answer to the question lies either in this person or in their addiction.
direct.advice:
First meaning
Be yourself. This is exactly what you need to do in this situation.

Second meaning
Be the King of Cups. Let yourself express your emotional side.

Third meaning
Overcome alcohol addiction before it causes serious problems.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Король Кубков: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:
First meaning
Showing your worst personality traits. In this situation, a man revealed some of his major flaws, and that had a negative effect on his life.

Second meaning
The King of Cups is offended. The reaction to the offense depends on the personality traits. He can stir up a scandal, react to an insult very emotionally and be out of sorts for a long time afterwards. The King of Cups is inclined to feel sorry for himself, to get all worked up over nothing.
Also, the card can refer to a man who does not fit this description but behaved like the King of Cups in a particular situation.

Third meaning
Disruptive behavior when one is drunk. A person drank too much and did something bad, stirred up a scandal, broke the law.
reversed.advice:
First meaning
Try not to do this. Work on yourself, so that you can control yourself. If the question is about the future, then some situation will trigger your worst qualities, so try to escape it if possible.

Second meaning
Most often the cards advise to react more calmly, not to take offense and make scandals.

Third meaning
Don't do this. Overcome alcohol addiction.

direct.short: Архетип Повешенный: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
A problem caused by the wrong pattern a person holds on to. It hinders their development and limits them. That is why destiny puts them in a difficult situation when there are no other options but to do something beyond this pattern. The Hanged Man is difficult and unpleasant to go through. A person is forced to act the way they never wanted to and were sure they would not. Deep down, they believe there are other options, and are trying to find them. However, the topic of the wrong pattern seems to come up everywhere: an unexpected conversation, information you accidentally heard or read, situations in the lives of people around.
The card could refer to a real problem at this life period. In this case, a person either does what the Hanged Man demands, or gets to the reversed meaning of the card. However, there is another option if the question is about the situation in general. It does not require a quick solution but one feels it is a problem anyway. It concerns deep limiting patterns — related to work, marriage, having children, lifestyle. In the future, that might escalate quickly and cause some difficulties. And then destiny will force you to fight your patterns. The card is perceived as a negative and painful one, but in a global sense it works for the benefit of the person.
direct.advice: Do not resist, do not try to escape from the Hanged Man. Do what needs to be done, even if you don't feel like it. Get rid of the pattern that stops you from moving on.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Повешенный: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: A person tries to resist what needs to be done. This can border on the absurd, insane behavior, when they are not looking for a way out any longer, but hold strong to their pattern and stand their ground to the last. Their resistance only makes the situation worse. In this case, fate can either tighten the restrictions even more, or make you stop and start thinking about it. It is often manifested by health problems, diseases, fractures.
reversed.advice: Do not take the situation to the point of absurdity. Accept the truth, however unpleasant it may be, and do what has to be done.

direct.short: Архетип The Popess (The High Priestess): внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description: A sudden insight, revelation, clarity. The truth is revealed at the moment when it's time to see it. A person suddenly sees a situation as it is, which changes their life. Often, an insight comes quietly, without unnecessary emotions, as if the eyes suddenly opened up. It becomes possible to see the truth. It can concern significant moments or everyday matters depending on a question. The High Priestess also represents the female energy, consciousness and subconsciousness, an ability to enter the state of flow.
direct.advice: You already have true knowledge, or it will come soon. Accept it in order to live on. Trust yourself — you'll get it right.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект The Popess (The High Priestess): время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: A person deliberately blocks knowledge of the truth because it doesn't serve their interest. Revelation destroys their idea of life, does not live up to their expectations and vision of the world. Accepting it is hard and painful, so it is easier to deny it deep in one's mind.
reversed.advice: Do not resist knowledge, embrace it. Sooner or later, it will come to you and make you accept it anyway.

direct.short: Архетип Шестерка Мечей: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
First meaning
The situation when you overestimated yourself and did not get the result you'd expected. Perhaps, you misunderstood something in the first place, and therefore, your self-esteem suffered — you were put in your place. A useful card that shows objective reality, but one can accept the truth in an uncomfortable and painful way.

Second meaning
The specific meaning of the card for certain questions: a road, way to somewhere.
direct.advice: Be ready for things to turn out differently. The results will be limited and less impressive. Take it for granted, do not blame anyone and draw conclusions to move on.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Шестерка Мечей: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:
First meaning
Successful constructive negotiations which lead to a solution that suits both sides. Such negotiations imply being interested in understanding each other, a desire not only to speak your mind but also to be heard, accept the point of view of the other and find a common solution. How favorable the card will mostly depend on a person's ability to negotiate skillfully.

Second meaning
Specific aspect in certain issues: signing a contract.
reversed.advice: Listen to your interlocutor's opinion, conduct high-level negotiations and try to reach a consensus — a result that will suit everyone.

direct.short: Архетип Туз Кубков: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description: A moment of joy, euphoria, delight. The scale depends on the question: an everyday situation or an important event in life. The card doesn't have a long-term effect, it means a shallow process and does not say how events will develop further. Emotional uplift can create illusions when a person doesn't pay attention to reality, makes illogical decisions they will regret later. Such reckless actions might lead to failure. Also, the Ace of Cups can reflect a state of motivation and dedication with little logic and constructive action.
direct.advice: Pamper yourself, live in this state of euphoria. Enjoy the process but don't make important decisions.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Туз Кубков: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: Intense joy followed by frustration and disappointment. Something went wrong. How unfavorable the situation is depends on the significance of the question. It can be just frustration or deeper emotions, even depression. Usually, the card's effect is short-term, if a person doesn't make themselves feel worse on their own.
reversed.advice: Experience all negative emotions and let go of the situation. Don't bottle up your feelings, but don't drown yourself in them either. Stay in this state and then move on.

direct.short: Архетип Девятка Кубков: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
High-level love. The ability to love, fully accept a partner just the way they are, without illusions and expectations. To be aware of their merits and demerits without trying to change them. This is creative love when a person invests in their partner because they want to do it, it makes them happy. They support the efforts of their loved one to become better because it is important for them. You can approve or disapprove of your partner's actions but love them anyway. If the question does not concern romantic relationships, then the card means moving in the right direction, love and support from God. In general, the card describes the highest level of attitude towards the world, nature, friends, and people around. The ability to love, invest oneself and totally accept things.
It is impossible to always live in the consciousness of the Nine of Cups — one will face internal contradictions, beliefs, conflicts anyway. They determine the development of a person. But if they reach this level once, they can get back to it.
direct.advice: Allow yourself love at the highest level — you are ready for it.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Девятка Кубков: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: A feeling that one invests more than they get back. A person is doing their best but does not feel it pays off. There are two possible options here: either they really do not get what they deserve, or they get it but in a different form. Their efforts pay off in such a way that they do not understand or appreciate. Expectations don't let them see the real picture.
reversed.advice: Try to change your perception and see everything you actually get for your efforts. Probably, you should try to re-establish some contacts to restore the balance. If it is impossible and your kindness is not appreciated, then leave.

direct.short: Архетип Пятерка Мечей: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
First meaning
A state of rage, aggression. A person crossed the line, which shouldn't be crossed, and succumbed to the destructive energy. They say and do things that hurt others. In this state, one loses their self-control, and the inner devil comes out. In a moment of rage, it seems that you need to break up relationships, connections, quit your job. The Five of Swords doesn't let you create and negotiate. The only way to save the situation is to end the conversation, cut off contacts, go to the Four of Swords, into the void, emptiness.

Second meaning
One started doing something they are not ready for. If they continue to do this now, they will fail.
direct.advice:
First meaning
At any cost, get out of the state of aggression and destruction. Try to restrain your inner devil. If a person you are talking to goes into a rage, put an end to that communication. A conversation in such a state will do no good.

Second meaning
You are trying to succeed in something you are not ready for. You can't help but give up. It is better to stop now and postpone it for a better time.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Пятерка Мечей: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: Something bad turns up in a person's worldview and character. They blame everyone for their troubles, take out their anger on those who cannot stand up for themselves, and behave inappropriately. In matters of health, the card means a life-threatening illness. Where it does not concern character or health, the card speaks of fanaticism, misperceptions and behavior.
reversed.advice: Protect your field from such people. If you notice any negative traits in your own character, ask for help. Be mindful and attentive to yourself, and try to figure out what you are doing wrong. Do not cross the line, do not get fanatical in any area of your life.

direct.short: Архетип Паж Кубков: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description: Changes associated with emotions that bring new opportunities. The card indicates a change in the emotional attitude to the issue but does not say whether it is for the better or worse. Something happens and changes the internal attitude towards a person or a situation, but it is not clear yet how it will develop further. At the initial stage, one can still control their feelings. That can be a new interest or extra attention, that will disappear if you find out more details. Or the person's feelings have just been hurt but their interlocutor's kind word or gesture can fix the situation and stop them from succumbing to negative emotions. Sometimes the meaning of the card concerns a change in the atmosphere, the emotional perception of a place or company.
direct.advice: Seize the opportunities that come with changes. Allow yourself new feelings and emotions. But if your question concerns something negative, do not surrender to the emotional process, do not let destructive states take over you.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Паж Кубков: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: The meaning coincides completely with the Page of Cups in the upright position.
reversed.advice: Обратите внимание на скрытые сомнения и не форсируйте результат.

direct.short: Архетип Десятка Мечей: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
First meaning
Loss, destruction. A person had plans, but something happened and destroyed them. It didn't turn out the way they imagined. It feels extremely painful like a loss of something important. It is difficult for the person to come to terms with it, they weep over their unfulfilled hopes. The card points out that the plan was unfeasible from the very beginning. Destiny made it possible to move in this direction, because there was an impulse. But when it became clear that the path won't benefit the person, it cut it off.

Second meaning
The specific aspect in questions about health: surgery, cutting something off, amputation.
direct.advice: Do not resist, accept the reality and make new plans.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Десятка Мечей: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:
First meaning
Loss, destruction that a person caused themselves. They understand that there is no point following the same path, so they decide to get out of it. They abandon the plans they made earlier. This is the right choice, but it feels painful and hard.

Second meaning
The specific aspect in questions about health: a small surgery.
reversed.advice: Stop following this path, no matter how difficult it is.

direct.short: Архетип Паж Жезлов: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
Changes that bring new social opportunities. This concerns the external part of life: where a person lives, how they work, processes in their life, their convenience. The card does not say whether these changes are for the better or worse, but they always lead to new opportunities for improving the social component of life. Whether the person will notice and seize these opportunities depends only on them. In questions about work, the card can mean both a worsening and an improvement in work conditions (for example, work schedule, logistics of movements, format of processes).
Sometimes the card speaks of the possibility of a new social level, career growth. As for relationships, their external component changes — the way partners communicate with each other, how they behave in relation to each other. In the spreads about the character, the card speaks of a change in behavior patterns, new habits, new behavior in different situations. It can also promise opportunities for personal development (for example, training, courses, new circle of friends).
direct.advice: Try to take advantage of these changes to improve your life. How you use the opportunities will determine whether the outcome will be favorable or not.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Паж Жезлов: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: The meaning coincides completely with the Page of Wands in the upright position.
reversed.advice: Обратите внимание на скрытые сомнения и не форсируйте результат.

direct.short: Архетип Королева Жезлов: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
First meaning
The Queen of Wands of the woman that the question is about. In this meaning it is connected with the zodiac sign according to the Western horoscope. Wands are a suit of people born under the fire signs — Sagittarius, Leo and Aries. Thus, if the woman belongs to one of these three signs and you know about it, then the card can have this meaning. If she belongs to another sign, or you do not know her sign of the zodiac, then it's not the case — look for the answer in the second or third meaning.
The Queen of Wands represents a woman as she is, with her own strengths and weaknesses, peculiarities, individual qualities. This is a "home" card, as if you are at home. It allows you to be your true self, and in this situation it is favorable. In this job, in this relationship, in this place, you are needed just the way you are. But one has to understand that both positive and negative traits come to the surface. The card does not judge: depending on the context of your question, merits or demerits will play a bigger role. If there is a choice between two options in the spread, and there appears the Queen of Wands, the cards say: no matter what advice we give, you will still do it your way.

Second meaning
Describes the character of the woman. It has no connection with the zodiac sign. The Queen of Wands means socially approved behavior. A woman's inner guidelines, her idea of "what is right" and "how it should be" coincide with the accepted norms concerning appearance, behavior, and communication. She is a nice person, it's a pleasure to talk to her. She is polite, honest, well-mannered, and knows how to support in difficult situations. Such people are tactful and reliable, they can be trusted. In a relationship, the Queen of Wands is a perfect wife and mother. However, she may be quite predictable, and wants to be like everyone else, so she can seem plain and unattractive.
The woman can be prone to sacrifice herself for the sake of family, children, serving something, or blindly follow the rules when their importance is exaggerated.
The card describes general traits of character but each person is individual and shows themselves in their own way.
Also, the card can refer to a woman who does not fit this description but behaved like the Queen of Wands in a particular situation.

Third meaning
Social role. The card either speaks of a person in power (quite often these are civil servants), or simply indicates status. In each situation, a person has a certain status: a parent, spouse, leader, colleague, friend. Social status implies definite behavior. The card points out the status of the person in this situation, the rest of the cards in the spread will provide you with more answers.
direct.advice:
First meaning
Be yourself. This is exactly what you need to do in this situation.

Second meaning
Be the Queen of Wands. Be open, friendly and polite.

Third meaning
Act according to your social role. Show yourself in the way that fits your status.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Королева Жезлов: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:
First meaning
Showing your worst personality traits. In this situation, a woman revealed some of her major flaws, and that had a negative effect on her life.

Second meaning
The Queen of Wands is offended. The reaction to the offense depends on the personality traits. Most often, she will either try to tell about her feelings straightaway or explain what hurt her after a while.
Also, the card can refer to a woman who does not fit this description but behaved like the Queen of Wands in a particular situation.

Third meaning
A person who breaks the rules within their social role. Their behavior doesn't fit their current status. For example, they act inappropriately as a boss, or as a parent. If the question is about the future, then in this situation one will have to break the rules.
reversed.advice:
First meaning
Try not to do this. Work it out, learn to control yourself because it hinders you. If the question is about the future, then some situation will trigger your worst qualities, so try to escape it if possible.

Second meaning
Talk about the situation, find out what made a person act in such a way. You might not see the whole picture.

Third meaning
Don't do this. Act according to your social role.

direct.short: Архетип Семерка Мечей: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description: Willpower, the ability to pull yourself together. The card speaks of having a backbone, leadership qualities, the ability to think it through, to work out your next steps, and come up with a backup plan if necessary. This is a positive card in terms of work issues and personal growth. However, if it concerns relationships, it is less favorable: a person is trying to control everything, impose their own point of view, manipulate. Constant tension, an attempt to keep track of everything can lead to health problems and psychosomatic disorders.
direct.advice: Analyze, consider all the options, mull over the issue thoroughly. Everything will work out for you if you take on a leadership role and act right. However, in matters concerning relationships or health, the card recommends letting go of excessive control — this will make the situation less stressful.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Семерка Мечей: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: A person can't control the situation because someone else is doing it. So, they act as an executor who has to obey someone else's will. Or they don't want to take responsibility to make decisions and outsource this to other people.
reversed.advice: Avoiding responsibility can cause problems in all areas of life. Don't run away from decision-making and active participation in the creation of your own life.

direct.short: Архетип Четверка Кубков: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
First meaning
Failed expectations. Most often, this is an answer to a specific question: everything will turn out not the way a person thinks. Inner ideas about the situation do not coincide with reality. Perhaps, deep down, one does not know how to act in order to get what they want. What they believe will work doesn't bring results, and there is no new plan yet. In a relationship, the card can mean high expectations.

Second meaning
Thoughts are all over the place. A person seemed to be stuck in one situation. They are constantly in the process of experiencing and discussing it. In such a state, they are not looking for a way out, therefore they do not see any possible solutions. They are not ready to act. The card can be fine for short periods of life. The main thing is to go through it on time and continue to act.
direct.advice:
First meaning
Be ready for the fact that everything will not turn out the way you imagined.

Second meaning
Finish this period of life and move on to the next stage of development.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Четверка Кубков: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:
First meaning
Self-deception, self-soothing, pseudo-optimism. Faced with failed expectations, a person starts convincing themselves that it is okay. They compare their situation to people who are doing even worse, in their opinion. In this state, the person does not take any action, does not want to change anything — only complains and suffers. The card says that the person needs to wait for the moment when they are ready for changes.

Second meaning
In rare cases, the card can have a positive meaning, when nothing can be changed in the situation. You need to hold up and wait for it to end. Better find some advantages and persuade yourself to be patient. But this should never replace a desire to change for the better.
reversed.advice:
First meaning
Look for ways to get out of stagnation and move to the next level. This approach will not help you improve your life.

Second meaning
Try to pay attention to the positive aspects until you can change everything.

direct.short: Архетип Четверка Жезлов: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
Stability, boredom, routine. A simple, uncomplicated, daily pattern of external circumstances. In work matters, this is the level of a "doer" whose actions must be accurate and quick. The work is boring and monotonous, there is no room for creativity. In a relationship, it means external routine, split responsibilities and no freedom. As for a person's character, the card says that one is extremely predictable and not well-rounded, and their mindset is simple and obvious. The card can be positive when it comes either to training where one needs to follow instructions and other people's rules, or to a start of any process implying developing new skills.
The card can appear at a certain life stage but it does not characterize life as a whole.
direct.advice: Get away from a boring scenario. It makes your life monotonous and stops you from growing. If you need to learn something, acquire new skills — make a plan of daily activities and stick to it.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Четверка Жезлов: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: An outlet, passion, hobby that brightens up your routine. The card can be positive if a hobby is a good way out of the situation and makes life a little better. However, the card is more often negative and it means an escape from reality, lack of seriousness. A person is not going to change their life, so they come up with something to get distracted. Often this card means a mistress or lover. Work-wise, a person is not ready to improve their position, so they find something positive to hold on to.
reversed.advice: In specific questions — find something that will bring you joy. Take up a hobby, start a joint business so that it brings you closer. In deep, significant spreads — do not look for an outlet. You need to radically change your life and move on. Don't be afraid of changes.

direct.short: Архетип Отшельник: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
The card has 2 meanings. You can identify which one applies by the nature of your question, or use a clarifying spread.

First meaning
The moment in life when a Higher Power transfers a person to a new, higher level. It feels like a loss of energy when you have enough energy only for basic needs. There is no strength and desire for active action, because the energy flow is directed to inner work, reevaluation. One wants to do something calming, spend time alone. There are no negative emotions or apathy in this process — only a peaceful calm state. Nothing special usually happens during this period in life, all external processes stop.

Second meaning
Reevaluation one realizes later. It seems as if a person switches off a specific area of life, loses interest in it and shifts their attention to other areas. Then the period ends, and they focus on this area again. Suddenly, the person is active and wants to express themselves. And when they get re-engaged in the activity, they notice that their attitude to certain issues has changed. Their preferences, opinions and reactions to different incentives are no longer the same. There happened a reevaluation of all values.
direct.advice: You need to be in silence now. Relax, don't try to make a fuss on purpose. Breathe out and let the natural development process take place. Now is not the best time for any endeavors.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Отшельник: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: An attempt to fake an activity when there is no need to. This fuss won't bring any results — only irritation and harm as you've almost run out of energy. If you keep on like this, you can have health problems that will make you calm down anyway.
reversed.advice: Stop making a fuss, it does no good to you. Now you need to relax and postpone active actions for a more favorable period.

direct.short: Архетип Десятка Пентаклей: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description:
First meaning
A higher level of energy or money. There appears something that increases a person's strength, allows them to both invest more and get more in return. Their income is increasing.

Second meaning
Particular aspect in questions about relationships: energy relationships. This is a feeling of unity in a couple, inner fullness, a subtle feeling of each other.

Third meaning
The specific aspect in questions about a one-time situation: a one-time increase in energy or money. It can be a lottery win, a prize, or a grant. Or any kind of one-time action that boosted a person's energy.
direct.advice: Do something that will lead you to a higher level of energy or money. You are capable of this.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Десятка Пентаклей: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description:
First meaning
Ease. Something works out quickly and naturally, one can do it easily and with pleasure. It is favorable in matters of work, hobbies, and communication with other people.

Second meaning
Carefree attitude. A person does not consider the situation serious, does not think it is important, and therefore does not make the necessary effort. But destiny expects a more serious attitude and actions from them.
You can understand the meaning with the help of other cards: if there are more positive cards in the spread, then it is the first meaning, if there are more negative cards — the second one.
reversed.advice:
First meaning
Take it easy. Don't exert yourself, act naturally. You got this.

Second meaning
You are being too carefree. Be careful, take it more seriously.

direct.short: Архетип Туз Пентаклей: внутренняя мудрость и вектор развития
direct.description: Maximum luck, a lot of positive moments. This is not a one-time success, but a long period when things happen in the best possible way. Its duration is unknown. The card comes after Justice when one has already untied the karmic knot and tackled a number of difficult problems they couldn't get down to for a long time. Whatever you're up to, luck will be on your side. During this period, it is favorable to start solving other difficulties since it is easier to do it now.
direct.advice: Solve an old problem to attract maximum luck into your life. If the question is about the future, wait for the Ace of Pentacles: the issue you are asking about cannot be tackled without luck.

reversed.short: Теневой аспект Туз Пентаклей: время для бережного переосмысления
reversed.description: A person is obsessed with money and prioritizes it. They seem to get good luck in a material form sacrificing all other aspects of life. For example, one's income increases but conditions, environment, emotional state leave much to be desired. This can be a life period when a person puts money first intentionally because it is necessary now. Also, the reversed card can indicate a hostile attitude. A person does something without putting their heart, energy and effort into the process. They do not listen to their inner voice but act automatically.
reversed.advice: Do not get hung up on money, trust your inner voice and the needs of the soul. If the question concerns money and at the moment it's your top priority, keep on acting the same way, but decide how long you have to wait to achieve your goal.
